register: Neutral-formal; the standard verb for subjecting an activity, market or system to public rules or oversight.
trap: Portuguese regulamentar and French réglementer may prompt reglamentar; in Spanish, regular is the unmarked verb, while reglamentar stresses detailed implementing rules.
example_tl: La Unión Europea pretende regular los sistemas de recomendación sin imponer un modelo editorial único a todas las plataformas del continente.
example_en: The European Union intends to regulate recommendation systems without imposing a single editorial model on every platform on the continent.
cloze: La Unión Europea pretende {{c1::regular}} los sistemas de recomendación sin imponer un modelo editorial único a todas las plataformas del continente.
note: The legacy rendering is correct; the teaching value lies in resisting cross-language pressure toward the narrower reglamentar.

register: Critical social-science and media vocabulary; marks the transformation of something into a tradable good, often with a negative evaluation.
trap: Comercializar means to market or sell something; it does not by itself express turning a social good, relationship or activity into a commodity.
example_tl: Las plataformas han mercantilizado la atención pública hasta convertir cada pausa, conversación y desplazamiento en una oportunidad de extracción de datos.
example_en: Platforms have commodified public attention to the point of turning every pause, conversation and journey into an opportunity for data extraction.
cloze: Las plataformas han {{c1::mercantilizado}} la atención pública hasta convertir cada pausa, conversación y desplazamiento en una oportunidad de extracción de datos.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate for the intended critical sense.

register: Neutral; vigilar covers systematic observation by state or private actors, while someter a vigilancia is more explicitly institutional.
trap: French surveiller and Italian sorvegliare do not license a Spanish cognate such as *surveillar; supervisar means oversee, not secretly or systematically monitor.
example_tl: Durante años, las autoridades vigilaron a activistas y periodistas mediante herramientas adquiridas oficialmente para investigar delitos graves y proteger la seguridad nacional.
example_en: For years, the authorities surveilled activists and journalists using tools officially acquired to investigate serious crimes and protect national security.
cloze: Durante años, las autoridades {{c1::vigilaron}} a activistas y periodistas mediante herramientas adquiridas oficialmente para investigar delitos graves y proteger la seguridad nacional.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate. Self-review: replaced the ambiguous provider with public authorities, making the agent and the acquisition of surveillance tools coherent.

register: Neutral in economic and public-policy writing; context determines whether the transfer is presented descriptively or critically.
trap: The infinitival to is not a purpose phrase here: translating it as para produces the malformed headword para privatizar found in the legacy gloss.
example_tl: El Gobierno privatizó la infraestructura de pagos sin establecer salvaguardias que impidieran que el nuevo operador excluyera a competidores y encareciera el servicio.
example_en: The government privatized the payment infrastructure without establishing safeguards to prevent the new operator from excluding competitors and making the service more expensive.
cloze: El Gobierno {{c1::privatizó}} la infraestructura de pagos sin establecer salvaguardias que impidieran que el nuevo operador excluyera a competidores y encareciera el servicio.
note: Materially corrects old_back, which mistakes the English infinitive marker for the Spanish purpose preposition para. Self-review: replaced the compressed impedir a alguien + infinitive construction with a finite subordinate clause for more idiomatic policy prose.

register: Neutral-critical for a lasting disturbance or radical alteration; avoids the promotional tone that revolucionar often carries in technology discourse.
trap: Interrumpir means stopping an ongoing process or service; it is too narrow when disrupt means profoundly altering an industry, institution or social system.
example_tl: La entrada de fondos especulativos trastocó el ecosistema mediático local, debilitó las redacciones y subordinó la cobertura a métricas de rentabilidad inmediata.
example_en: The arrival of speculative funds disrupted the local media ecosystem, weakened newsrooms and subordinated coverage to metrics of immediate profitability.
cloze: La entrada de fondos especulativos {{c1::trastocó}} el ecosistema mediático local, debilitó las redacciones y subordinó la cobertura a métricas de rentabilidad inmediata.
note: The isolated English prompt is polysemous. This note adopts the lasting industry-change sense supported by the topic; old_back remains valid for interrupting an event or service.

register: Neutral technical usage; cifrar is the established standard term, while encriptar is also accepted and widespread in computing.
trap: Codificar means to encode data in another representation; it does not necessarily mean protecting it cryptographically, so it is not a synonym for cifrar.
example_tl: La aplicación cifra los mensajes de extremo a extremo, pero conserva metadatos suficientes para reconstruir redes de contacto y hábitos de uso.
example_en: The application encrypts messages end to end but retains enough metadata to reconstruct contact networks and patterns of use.
cloze: La aplicación {{c1::cifra}} los mensajes de extremo a extremo, pero conserva metadatos suficientes para reconstruir redes de contacto y hábitos de uso.
note: The legacy rendering is correct; the note distinguishes encryption from mere encoding and records the accepted technical alternative.

register: Neutral-formal in technical and institutional prose; normalizar is also used when a formal standard or common specification is being established.
trap: English standardize, French standardiser and Italian standardizzare can prompt *standardizar; Spanish requires the initial e in estandarizar.
example_tl: El regulador estandarizó los formatos de los informes de transparencia para que periodistas y académicos pudieran comparar las decisiones de moderación entre plataformas.
example_en: The regulator standardized the formats of transparency reports so that journalists and academics could compare moderation decisions across platforms.
cloze: El regulador {{c1::estandarizó}} los formatos de los informes de transparencia para que periodistas y académicos pudieran comparar las decisiones de moderación entre plataformas.
note: The legacy rendering is correct; retention is justified by the cross-language spelling trap and the technical alternative normalizar. Self-review: specified formatos so that both estandarizar and normalizar are idiomatic alternatives in the example.

register: Neutral in media, political and regulatory prose; context usually supplies the negative evaluation.
trap: The English infinitive marker to is not translated with para in a headword; para censurar expresses purpose, not the verb itself.
example_tl: El Gobierno censuró varias investigaciones alegando motivos de seguridad nacional, aunque los documentos retirados solo acreditaban la existencia de contratos opacos con empresas extranjeras.
example_en: The government censored several investigations on national-security grounds, although the withdrawn documents merely established the existence of opaque contracts with foreign companies.
cloze: El Gobierno {{c1::censuró}} varias investigaciones alegando motivos de seguridad nacional, aunque los documentos retirados solo acreditaban la existencia de contratos opacos con empresas extranjeras.
note: Materially corrects old_back, which mistakes the English infinitive marker for the Spanish purpose preposition para. Self-review: added la existencia de because documents establish the existence of contracts rather than accrediting contracts directly.

register: Neutral-critical for extracting unfair advantage from people or circumstances; aprovecharse de foregrounds the abuse more explicitly.
trap: Portuguese explorar and French exploiter should not prompt Spanish explorar or *exploitar here; exploiting workers, resources or dependency is explotar.
example_tl: La plataforma explotó la dependencia económica de sus repartidores para trasladarles los riesgos del negocio sin reconocerles derechos laborales ni capacidad negociadora.
example_en: The platform exploited its couriers' economic dependence to shift business risks onto them without recognizing labor rights or bargaining power.
cloze: La plataforma {{c1::explotó}} la dependencia económica de sus repartidores para trasladarles los riesgos del negocio sin reconocerles derechos laborales ni capacidad negociadora.
note: Materially corrects old_back, which turns the headword into a purpose phrase with para. The example fixes the unfair-advantage sense rather than the unrelated sense explode.

register: Neutral in analytical and institutional prose; influir en is more frequent, while transitive influenciar is also standard Spanish.
trap: English influence, French influencer and Italian influenzare favor a direct object; Spanish influir is intransitive and normally governs en or sobre.
example_tl: Los grandes anunciantes influyeron en la cobertura económica al amenazar con retirar campañas de los medios que investigaban sus prácticas fiscales.
example_en: Major advertisers influenced economic coverage by threatening to withdraw campaigns from media outlets investigating their tax practices.
cloze: Los grandes anunciantes {{c1::influyeron en}} la cobertura económica al amenazar con retirar campañas de los medios que investigaban sus prácticas fiscales.
note: The legacy rendering gives the correct verb but omits its required government; the production headword restores en.

register: Neutral; resistirse a expresses refusal or opposition, whereas transitive resistir more often means withstanding pressure, damage or temptation.
trap: English permits resist with a direct object; Spanish normally uses resistirse a for opposing an action, proposal or change, but resistir algo for enduring it.
example_tl: Varias plataformas se resistieron a facilitar datos a los investigadores, pese a haber invocado reiteradamente su compromiso con la transparencia.
example_en: Several platforms resisted providing data to researchers, despite having repeatedly invoked their commitment to transparency.
cloze: Varias plataformas {{c1::se resistieron a}} facilitar datos a los investigadores, pese a haber invocado reiteradamente su compromiso con la transparencia.
note: The source is underspecified. The note selects the common oppose-or-refuse sense; old_back remains valid for the distinct withstand sense.

register: Neutral-formal argumentative usage for disputing the validity of a premise, claim or decision; desafiar is more confrontational.
trap: Desafiar is valid for confronting a rival or defying authority, but it is often a calque when challenge means question a claim or assumption.
example_tl: El informe cuestiona la premisa de que una mayor personalización mejora necesariamente la calidad informativa o fortalece la autonomía de los usuarios.
example_en: The report challenges the premise that greater personalization necessarily improves information quality or strengthens users' autonomy.
cloze: El informe {{c1::cuestiona}} la premisa de que una mayor personalización mejora necesariamente la calidad informativa o fortalece la autonomía de los usuarios.
note: The isolated prompt is polysemous. This note adopts the argumentative sense; old_back is appropriate for confront, defy or issue a challenge.

register: Neutral; the pronominal form is standard when the subject changes in response to circumstances, rules or an environment.
trap: English omits the reflexive marker and the legacy adaptar is only transitive; in the intransitive sense, use adaptarse a something.
example_tl: Los medios locales se adaptaron a las nuevas reglas de distribución sin renunciar a investigar a los actores que financiaban la plataforma.
example_en: Local media adapted to the new distribution rules without giving up investigating the actors that financed the platform.
cloze: Los medios locales {{c1::se adaptaron a}} las nuevas reglas de distribución sin renunciar a investigar a los actores que financiaban la plataforma.
note: The source lacks an object, so the note follows the common intransitive reading and materially expands old_back with the reflexive marker and governed preposition.

register: Neutral-formal for implementing a law, policy or safeguard; implantar is often preferable for installing a system, while implementar is valid but bureaucratic.
trap: Implement is collocationally broad in English: Spanish commonly applies a rule or measure, puts a plan into practice, and installs a system.
example_tl: La comisión aplicó las nuevas salvaguardias de forma gradual para que los medios pequeños pudieran cumplirlas sin abandonar servicios esenciales.
example_en: The commission implemented the new safeguards gradually so that small media outlets could comply with them without abandoning essential services.
cloze: La comisión {{c1::aplicó}} las nuevas salvaguardias de forma gradual para que los medios pequeños pudieran cumplirlas sin abandonar servicios esenciales.
note: The legacy rendering is correct for the policy sense fixed by the example; the register line prevents overgeneralizing it to systems or plans.

register: Neutral in analytical and scientific prose; prever is often used for a reasoned forecast or anticipation and is interchangeable in this example.
trap: Predecir follows decir in key forms: the preterite is predijo, not *predeció, and the past participle is predicho, not *predecido.
example_tl: El modelo predijo un aumento de la polarización, pero sus autores no explicaron qué datos históricos sustentaban una conclusión tan precisa.
example_en: The model predicted an increase in polarization, but its authors did not explain which historical data supported such a precise conclusion.
cloze: El modelo {{c1::predijo}} un aumento de la polarización, pero sus autores no explicaron qué datos históricos sustentaban una conclusión tan precisa.
note: The legacy headword is correct; retention is justified by the high-value irregular morphology demonstrated in the new example.

register: Neutral in economic and public-policy prose; the object of investment may be money, time, institutional capacity or political capital.
trap: Portuguese investir and Italian investire can prompt *investir; Spanish uses invertir and normally introduces the investment target with en.
example_tl: El Estado invirtió en centros públicos de datos para reducir la dependencia tecnológica sin subvencionar otra generación de proveedores dominantes.
example_en: The state invested in public data centers to reduce technological dependence without subsidizing another generation of dominant providers.
cloze: El Estado {{c1::invirtió en}} centros públicos de datos para reducir la dependencia tecnológica sin subvencionar otra generación de proveedores dominantes.
note: The legacy rendering gives the correct verb but omits the governed preposition; the production headword restores en and exposes cross-language interference.

register: Written-formal and often critical; socavar evokes a gradual weakening of authority, legitimacy, rights or institutional capacity.
example_tl: La concentración publicitaria socava la independencia editorial porque permite que unos pocos intermediarios penalicen económicamente a los medios por publicar información incómoda.
example_en: Advertising concentration undermines editorial independence because it allows a few intermediaries to penalize media outlets financially for publishing uncomfortable information.
cloze: La concentración publicitaria {{c1::socava}} la independencia editorial porque permite que unos pocos intermediarios penalicen económicamente a los medios por publicar información incómoda.
note: The legacy rendering is correct. The alternatives are natural in the same sentence, though debilitar states the metaphor less strongly. Self-review: replaced the strained castigar una cobertura with penalizar a los medios por publicar.

register: Neutral-formal; con introduces the other participant and en introduces the project, task or field of collaboration.
trap: French collaborer à and Italian collaborare a can prompt *colaborar a un proyecto; standard Spanish uses colaborar en un proyecto and con a participant.
example_tl: Universidades y redacciones colaboraron con organizaciones civiles en la creación de un archivo público que documenta campañas coordinadas de desinformación electoral.
example_en: Universities and newsrooms collaborated with civil-society organizations to create a public archive documenting coordinated electoral disinformation campaigns.
cloze: Universidades y redacciones {{c1::colaboraron con}} organizaciones civiles {{c1::en}} la creación de un archivo público que documenta campañas coordinadas de desinformación electoral.
note: The legacy rendering is correct but omits its two productive government patterns; the example and cloze restore both. Self-review: expanded en un archivo to the more idiomatic en la creación de un archivo.

register: Neutral-formal, especially common for obtaining entry to data, documents, services, systems or institutional spaces.
trap: English access is transitive, but Spanish acceder is intransitive and requires a before the object; the legacy headword therefore omits essential government.
example_tl: Los investigadores solo accedieron a los registros después de que un tribunal obligara a la plataforma a preservar las pruebas.
example_en: The researchers accessed the records only after a court ordered the platform to preserve the evidence.
cloze: Los investigadores solo {{c1::accedieron a}} los registros después de que un tribunal obligara a la plataforma a preservar las pruebas.
note: Materially expands old_back by adding the governed preposition required in the source sense.

register: Neutral corporate and policy vocabulary in Spain; externalizar stresses moving a function outside, while subcontratar stresses the third-party contract.
trap: Portuguese terceirizar may prompt tercerizar; that form is established in parts of Latin America, while European Spanish normally prefers externalizar or subcontratar.
example_tl: La plataforma externalizó la moderación de contenidos para reducir costes, pero perdió capacidad para supervisar decisiones que afectaban a millones de usuarios.
example_en: The platform outsourced content moderation to cut costs but lost the capacity to oversee decisions affecting millions of users.
cloze: La plataforma {{c1::externalizó}} la moderación de contenidos para reducir costes, pero perdió capacidad para supervisar decisiones que afectaban a millones de usuarios.
note: The legacy rendering is correct for European Spanish; the alternative is interchangeable in the example but foregrounds the contractual arrangement.

register: Specialist media and technology usage; curar contenidos is established in Spain for selecting, organising and contextualising material.
trap: Curar normally means heal or cure, while conservar is preserve; in media, curar contenidos is the established specialist extension.
example_tl: Los editores curan contenidos de múltiples fuentes, pero siguen respondiendo de la jerarquía narrativa y de la verificación de cada enlace.
example_en: Editors curate content from multiple sources, but they remain responsible for the narrative hierarchy and for verifying every link.
cloze: Los editores {{c1::curan contenidos}} de múltiples fuentes, pero siguen respondiendo de la jerarquía narrativa y de la verificación de cada enlace.
note: Materially corrects old_back, which gives conservar and misses the media-specific sense. Self-review: retained contenidos in the headword because bare curar does not reliably signal this usage.

register: Neutral technical usage; incrustar is especially precise for placing media or code directly inside a webpage or digital document.
trap: Integrar is broader than embed, and insertar does not necessarily imply that the content runs or remains inside the host page.
example_tl: La redacción incrustó el vídeo original en la investigación interactiva para que los lectores pudieran revisar la evidencia sin abandonar la página.
example_en: The newsroom embedded the original video in the interactive investigation so that readers could review the evidence without leaving the page.
cloze: La redacción {{c1::incrustó}} el vídeo original en la investigación interactiva para que los lectores pudieran revisar la evidencia sin abandonar la página.
note: The old gloss integrar is possible in a broad product sense, but incrustar is the sharper web-development rendering for the example.

register: Neutral technical and institutional usage; interactuar con describes systems, organisations or actors working through a point of contact.
trap: The English verb is not normally interfazarse; interfaz is a noun, while Spanish uses interactuar con or servir de interfaz con.
example_tl: Para supervisar contratos transfronterizos, el regulador necesita interactuar con sistemas que aplican normas de privacidad incompatibles entre sí.
example_en: To oversee cross-border contracts, the regulator needs to interface with systems that apply incompatible privacy rules.
cloze: Para supervisar contratos transfronterizos, el regulador necesita {{c1::interactuar con}} sistemas que aplican normas de privacidad incompatibles entre sí.
note: Materially diverges from old_back: interconectar describes connecting things, whereas the source verb here describes a party or system interacting with another.

register: Formal analytical usage; converger en is used for distinct processes, positions or trajectories arriving at a shared point or outcome.
trap: Spanish commonly uses converger en or converger hacia; the English-like preposition a is not the default before a shared outcome.
example_tl: Aunque partan de diagnósticos distintos, las dos comisiones convergieron en una propuesta común para limitar la extracción comercial de datos personales.
example_en: Although they started from different diagnoses, the two commissions converged on a common proposal to limit the commercial extraction of personal data.
cloze: Aunque partan de diagnósticos distintos, las dos comisiones {{c1::convergieron en}} una propuesta común para limitar la extracción comercial de datos personales.
note: The legacy headword is close but omits the productive governed frame. Self-review: selected converger en because the example concerns agreement on an outcome, not merely movement towards it.

register: Neutral-formal; aprovechar is the unmarked Spanish choice for using an asset, position or resource to obtain an advantage.
trap: Apalancar is a specialised financial term, not a blanket translation of leverage in policy or media prose; para aprovechar is a purpose phrase, not the headword.
example_tl: Los medios públicos deben aprovechar sus archivos históricos sin convertirlos en una fuente opaca de entrenamiento para modelos comerciales.
example_en: Public media outlets should leverage their historical archives without turning them into an opaque source of training data for commercial models.
cloze: Los medios públicos deben {{c1::aprovechar}} sus archivos históricos sin convertirlos en una fuente opaca de entrenamiento para modelos comerciales.
note: Materially corrects old_back by removing the English infinitive marker's accidental para. The example fixes the general strategic-use sense rather than the narrow financial one.

register: Formal policy and legal usage; hacer cumplir presents an authority as ensuring that a rule, law or standard is obeyed.
trap: Imponer means impose, not necessarily enforce: an authority can impose a rule without actually making compliance happen.
example_tl: La autoridad debe hacer cumplir las normas de transparencia incluso cuando los grandes anunciantes amenacen con retirar sus campañas del mercado nacional.
example_en: The authority must enforce transparency rules even when major advertisers threaten to withdraw their campaigns from the national market.
cloze: La autoridad debe {{c1::hacer cumplir}} las normas de transparencia incluso cuando los grandes anunciantes amenacen con retirar sus campañas del mercado nacional.
note: Materially corrects old_back: imponer selects the act of laying down a rule, while the source selects the subsequent duty to ensure compliance.

register: Neutral-formal policy and legal usage; restringir is common when access, rights or activity are narrowed by an explicit rule.
trap: Restringir is transitive in this sense; the reflexive restringirse means to limit oneself or to be confined, not to impose a restriction.
example_tl: El nuevo marco restringe el acceso de las plataformas a determinados datos públicos, pero mantiene excepciones para investigaciones de interés general.
example_en: The new framework restricts platforms’ access to certain government data, but it maintains exceptions for research in the public interest.
cloze: El nuevo marco {{c1::restringe}} el acceso de las plataformas a determinados datos públicos, pero mantiene excepciones para investigaciones de interés general.
note: The old gloss is a valid bare equivalent; retention is justified by the formal policy register and the useful contrast with the broader limitar.

register: Specialist data-policy usage; elaborar perfiles describes inferring a person's traits, preferences or behaviour from collected signals.
trap: Perfilar can mean outline or define a strategy, but in data protection prose elaborar perfiles makes the creation of user profiles explicit.
example_tl: Las plataformas elaboran perfiles de los usuarios a partir de señales aparentemente inocuas, desde el horario de conexión hasta la cadencia de lectura.
example_en: Platforms profile users from apparently innocuous signals, from connection times to reading cadence.
cloze: Las plataformas {{c1::elaboran perfiles}} de los usuarios a partir de señales aparentemente inocuas, desde el horario de conexión hasta la cadencia de lectura.
note: Materially sharpens old_back: perfilar is possible in some contexts, but the example targets data profiling rather than outlining a plan or silhouette.

register: Neutral technical and statistical usage; agregar datos means combining separate observations into a larger dataset or summary.
trap: Agregar can also mean add, but in data analysis the object and context distinguish aggregation from merely appending another item.
example_tl: El estudio agrega datos de movilidad y consumo para mostrar cómo la desigualdad territorial condiciona el acceso efectivo a los servicios digitales.
example_en: The study aggregates mobility and consumption data to show how territorial inequality conditions effective access to digital services.
cloze: El estudio {{c1::agrega}} datos de movilidad y consumo para mostrar cómo la desigualdad territorial condiciona el acceso efectivo a los servicios digitales.
note: Materially corrects old_back by removing para. Self-review: chose agregar datos, the established statistical collocation, rather than forcing the less precise sumar.

register: Technical and critical analytical usage; ofuscar covers making code, data or an explanation deliberately difficult to understand.
trap: Ofuscar is not simply ocultar: the central idea is obscuring intelligibility or traceability, often while leaving the material technically present.
example_tl: Algunas empresas ofuscan deliberadamente el código de sus aplicaciones para dificultar auditorías independientes sobre sus prácticas de recopilación de datos.
example_en: Some companies deliberately obfuscate their application code to make independent audits of their data-collection practices more difficult.
cloze: Algunas empresas {{c1::ofuscan}} deliberadamente el código de sus aplicaciones para dificultar auditorías independientes sobre sus prácticas de recopilación de datos.
note: The legacy rendering is correct; the note preserves the specialised sense rather than treating ofuscar as a generic synonym for hide.

register: Formal critical and historical usage; perpetuar usually describes keeping an injustice, hierarchy, narrative or practice in place.
trap: Perpetuar is not perpetrar: the former makes something continue indefinitely, whereas the latter means commit an offence or harmful act.
example_tl: La retórica de la excepcionalidad perpetúa políticas de vigilancia que, una vez normalizadas, resultan muy difíciles de desmontar democráticamente.
example_en: The rhetoric of exceptionalism perpetuates surveillance policies that, once normalised, prove very difficult to dismantle democratically.
cloze: La retórica de la excepcionalidad {{c1::perpetúa}} políticas de vigilancia que, una vez normalizadas, resultan muy difíciles de desmontar democráticamente.
note: The old gloss is accurate. Retention is justified by the high-value false-cognate contrast with perpetrar and the strongly evaluative policy collocation.

register: Neutral-formal for handling a complex institutional, regulatory or social environment; navegar is better reserved for literal or interface contexts.
trap: Navegar is natural for a website or boat, but English navigate a market or bureaucracy often calls for desenvolverse en or sortear in Spanish.
example_tl: Las redacciones pequeñas deben desenvolverse en un mercado dominado por plataformas que cambian sus condiciones comerciales sin previo aviso.
example_en: Small newsrooms must navigate a market dominated by platforms that change their commercial terms without warning.
cloze: Las redacciones pequeñas deben {{c1::desenvolverse en}} un mercado dominado por plataformas que cambian sus condiciones comerciales sin previo aviso.
note: The source is polysemous. This note selects the figurative institutional sense and materially diverges from old_back, which gives only the literal cognate navegar.

register: Neutral-formal diplomatic and institutional usage; mediar entre identifies an intermediary helping opposing parties reach an agreement.
trap: Spanish uses mediar entre the parties for this role; mediar con is not the normal equivalent of English mediate with someone.
example_tl: La organización medió entre el Gobierno y las familias afectadas para desbloquear una negociación que llevaba meses estancada.
example_en: The organisation mediated between the government and the affected families to unblock negotiations that had been stalled for months.
cloze: La organización {{c1::medió entre}} el Gobierno y las familias afectadas para desbloquear una negociación que llevaba meses estancada.
note: The old gloss is a valid root equivalent but omits the productive frame. Self-review: used mediar entre rather than mediar con to match standard Spanish government.

register: Formal analytical and strategic usage; concebir suggests forming a considered picture of a possible future or institutional design.
trap: Prever means foresee or predict, not envision: it focuses on anticipated likelihood rather than on a deliberately imagined possibility.
example_tl: El proyecto concibe una esfera pública digital en la que la transparencia no dependa de decisiones opacas de empresas privadas.
example_en: The project envisions a digital public sphere in which transparency does not depend on opaque decisions by private companies.
cloze: El proyecto {{c1::concibe}} una esfera pública digital en la que la transparencia no dependa de decisiones opacas de empresas privadas.
note: Materially corrects old_back, which gives prever. Self-review: selected concebir for a planned institutional vision, while reserving prever for forecasting an outcome.

register: Technical business, policy and performance-analysis usage; the phrase makes the comparison standard explicit rather than implying a casual comparison.
trap: Comparar alone does not encode benchmarking; Spanish needs a reference point, standard or peer group to express the specialised sense.
example_tl: La auditoría compara las prácticas de moderación de la plataforma con un referente europeo que publica criterios y resultados verificables.
example_en: The audit benchmarks the platform's moderation practices against a European standard that publishes verifiable criteria and results.
cloze: La auditoría {{c1::compara}} las prácticas de moderación de la plataforma {{c1::con un referente}} europeo que publica criterios y resultados verificables.
note: Materially expands old_back, which gives the underspecified comparar. The production headword supplies the benchmark's required reference point.

register: Formal critical and technical usage; eludir suggests deliberately avoiding a rule, control, obstacle or accountability mechanism.
trap: Evitar is a broad equivalent, but eludir or sortear better signals deliberate circumvention of an institutional control; puentear is specialist jargon.
example_tl: Los intermediarios intentaron eludir los controles de competencia mediante adquisiciones escalonadas y complejas estructuras societarias transfronterizas difíciles de rastrear.
example_en: The intermediaries tried to bypass competition controls through staggered acquisitions and complex cross-border corporate structures that were difficult to trace.
cloze: Los intermediarios intentaron {{c1::eludir}} los controles de competencia mediante adquisiciones escalonadas y complejas estructuras societarias transfronterizas difíciles de rastrear.
note: Materially sharpens old_back: evitar is possible but too general for the deliberate circumvention sense fixed by the regulatory example.

register: Written-formal academic, journalistic and legal usage; dilucidar means clarify a difficult question through analysis or evidence.
trap: Dilucidar is transitive and means clarify or resolve a question; it is not a purpose phrase beginning with para, as the old gloss suggests.
example_tl: El informe dilucida qué mecanismos permitieron que una campaña coordinada alterase el debate público sin dejar una huella financiera evidente.
example_en: The report elucidates which mechanisms allowed a coordinated campaign to alter public debate without leaving an evident financial trail.
cloze: El informe {{c1::dilucida}} qué mecanismos permitieron que una campaña coordinada alterase el debate público sin dejar una huella financiera evidente.
note: Materially corrects old_back by removing para. Self-review: used a direct interrogative clause after dilucidar, a natural formal construction in Spanish investigative prose.

register: Neutral-formal critical usage; erosionar works for the gradual weakening of trust, legitimacy, rights or institutional capacity.
trap: Erosionar is fully idiomatic for abstract effects in Spanish; it is not restricted to physical wear and need not be replaced by the stronger socavar.
example_tl: La opacidad erosiona la confianza ciudadana cuando las instituciones publican cifras sin explicar los criterios empleados para producirlas.
example_en: Opacity erodes public trust when institutions publish figures without explaining the criteria used to produce them.
cloze: La opacidad {{c1::erosiona}} la confianza ciudadana cuando las instituciones publican cifras sin explicar los criterios empleados para producirlas.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate. Retention is justified by the productive metaphorical collocation and the distinction between gradual erosion and sharper undermining.

register: Neutral media and service usage; suscribirse a is standard for joining a publication, newsletter or paid service.
trap: Suscribir without the reflexive marker means sign or endorse something; subscribing to a service requires suscribirse a, while abonarse a is more service-oriented.
example_tl: Miles de lectores se suscribieron a la revista para recibir investigaciones que los medios generalistas habían dejado fuera de agenda.
example_en: Thousands of readers subscribed to the magazine to receive investigations that mainstream media had left off the agenda.
cloze: Miles de lectores {{c1::se suscribieron a}} la revista para recibir investigaciones que los medios generalistas habían dejado fuera de agenda.
note: Materially expands old_back with the reflexive marker and preposition. The source is polysemous; this note selects the publication or service sense.

register: Neutral-formal academic, statistical and policy usage; cuantificar expresses measuring an amount or effect numerically.
trap: Cuantificar is not merely contar: it assigns a measurable magnitude or value, including to an abstract effect such as democratic cost.
example_tl: La investigación cuantifica el coste democrático de la desinformación sin reducir sus efectos a una sola métrica de audiencia.
example_en: The research quantifies the democratic cost of disinformation without reducing its effects to a single audience metric.
cloze: La investigación {{c1::cuantifica}} el coste democrático de la desinformación sin reducir sus efectos a una sola métrica de audiencia.
note: The legacy rendering is correct. Retention is justified by the academic register and the distinction between assigning magnitude and simply counting items.

register: Formal diplomatic, geopolitical and legal usage; tomar represalias describes a deliberate punitive response to another actor's action.
trap: Vengarse is more personal and emotional; retaliate in interstate or institutional prose normally calls for tomar represalias or responder con medidas.
example_tl: El Gobierno amenazó con tomar represalias comerciales si la empresa extranjera divulgaba documentos que comprometían a sus aliados estratégicos.
example_en: The government threatened to retaliate commercially if the foreign company disclosed documents that implicated its strategic allies.
cloze: El Gobierno amenazó con {{c1::tomar represalias}} comerciales si la empresa extranjera divulgaba documentos que comprometían a sus aliados estratégicos.
note: Materially corrects old_back with the idiomatic fixed expression. Self-review: kept the commercial modifier outside the cloze because it specifies the type of retaliation, not the verb phrase.

register: Neutral-formal political, institutional and media usage; respaldar signals public support for a proposal, position or person.
trap: Endosar is mainly used for transferring or guaranteeing a financial instrument; it is not the neutral Spanish verb for endorsing a policy.
example_tl: La mayoría parlamentaria respaldó la propuesta, aunque varios diputados advirtieron que el texto podía debilitar la supervisión judicial.
example_en: The parliamentary majority endorsed the proposal, although several MPs warned that the text could weaken judicial oversight.
cloze: La mayoría parlamentaria {{c1::respaldó}} la propuesta, aunque varios diputados advirtieron que el texto podía debilitar la supervisión judicial.
note: The old gloss avalar is a valid alternative for a proposal, but respaldar is the broadest production-ready headword; the alternatives are limited to genuine support senses.

register: Neutral technical and cybersecurity usage; autenticar confirms that a user, device or document is genuinely what it claims to be.
trap: Autenticar is not authorise: authentication establishes identity or authenticity, while authorisation determines which actions or resources are permitted.
example_tl: El sistema autentica a cada usuario antes de permitirle consultar expedientes sensibles, pero no determina qué permisos debe concederle después.
example_en: The system authenticates each user before allowing them to consult sensitive files, but it does not determine which permissions to grant afterwards.
cloze: El sistema {{c1::autentica}} a cada usuario antes de permitirle consultar expedientes sensibles, pero no determina qué permisos debe concederle después.
note: Autentificar in old_back is possible, but autenticar is the concise standard technical headword here. Self-review: made the authentication/authorisation distinction explicit in the example.

register: Formal economic usage; devaluar normally describes an intentional reduction in a currency's official value, while depreciar is broader.
trap: Desvalorizar is not the standard monetary choice in European Spanish; depreciar often describes market decline, whereas devaluar implies an official decision.
example_tl: El Gobierno devaluó la moneda después de que los mercados perdieran confianza en la capacidad fiscal del Estado que la respaldaba.
example_en: The government devalued the currency after markets lost confidence in the fiscal capacity of the state backing it.
cloze: El Gobierno {{c1::devaluó}} la moneda después de que los mercados perdieran confianza en la capacidad fiscal del Estado que la respaldaba.
note: Materially corrects old_back, which uses a nonstandard or nonmonetary-looking rendering. Self-review: fixed the example to the deliberate official-currency sense that distinguishes devaluar from depreciar.

register: Neutral-formal policy, management and analytical usage; priorizar is standard in Spain for ranking objectives or actions by importance.
trap: Priorizar normally takes a direct object, while the equally natural dar prioridad a requires the preposition a; do not combine the two frames.
example_tl: La estrategia prioriza la alfabetización mediática porque una ciudadanía informada resulta más resistente a campañas coordinadas de manipulación política.
example_en: The strategy prioritizes media literacy because an informed public is more resistant to coordinated political-manipulation campaigns.
cloze: La estrategia {{c1::prioriza}} la alfabetización mediática porque una ciudadanía informada resulta más resistente a campañas coordinadas de manipulación política.
note: The legacy rendering is correct. Retention is justified by the productive contrast between the direct verb and the governed frame dar prioridad a in policy prose.

register: Formal-analytical; trascender marks going beyond the scope or limits of a debate, institution or national boundary.
trap: Trascender can also mean become public or known, as in trascendió a la prensa; that dissemination sense is different from exceeding a limit.
example_tl: La disputa trasciende las fronteras nacionales porque la arquitectura de la red condiciona también la autonomía tecnológica de los países vecinos.
example_en: The dispute transcends national borders because the network's architecture also conditions the technological autonomy of neighbouring countries.
cloze: La disputa {{c1::trasciende}} las fronteras nacionales porque la arquitectura de la red condiciona también la autonomía tecnológica de los países vecinos.
note: The legacy rendering is correct. The example selects the abstract scope-exceeding sense rather than trascender a la opinión pública, which means become known.

register: Neutral-formal for sustained intellectual or experiential engagement; the figurative frame is common in journalism and research prose.
trap: For immersing oneself in a subject or body of material, Spanish normally uses the reflexive sumergirse en; transitive sumergir means immerse another object or person.
example_tl: Los periodistas se sumergieron en miles de documentos desclasificados para reconstruir cómo la alianza había normalizado la vigilancia transfronteriza.
example_en: The journalists immersed themselves in thousands of declassified documents to reconstruct how the alliance had normalised cross-border surveillance.
cloze: Los periodistas {{c1::se sumergieron en}} miles de documentos desclasificados para reconstruir cómo la alianza había normalizado la vigilancia transfronteriza.
note: Materially expands old_back, which gives the bare transitive sumergir and misses the reflexive prepositional frame needed for the documentary-study sense.

alts: poner algo en contraste con algo
register: Written-formal in criticism and analysis for placing two objects, claims or accounts in deliberate comparative contrast.
trap: Spanish spells the verb yuxtaponer, not *yustaponer; the common construction is yuxtaponer one element a another, not a literal English-shaped form.
example_tl: El documental yuxtapone las promesas públicas del grupo a sus auditorías internas para revelar la distancia entre discurso corporativo y práctica regulatoria.
example_en: The documentary juxtaposes the group's public promises with its internal audits to reveal the distance between corporate discourse and regulatory practice.
cloze: El documental {{c1::yuxtapone}} las promesas públicas del grupo {{c1::a}} sus auditorías internas para revelar la distancia entre discurso corporativo y práctica regulatoria.
note: The old cognate is accurate, but the note supplies the productive prepositional frame and the spelling trap that matter in formal analytical writing.

alts: relegar algo a un segundo plano
register: Written-neutral and figurative when one issue, event or achievement makes another less noticeable or less important.
trap: Ensombrecer can mean cast a negative pall over something; eclipsar or relegar a un segundo plano more directly expresses reduced salience without that emotional colouring.
example_tl: La cobertura sobre la inteligencia artificial eclipsó el conflicto laboral, aunque miles de trabajadores seguían afrontando despidos inminentes.
example_en: The coverage of artificial intelligence overshadowed the labour dispute, although thousands of workers were still facing imminent redundancies.
cloze: La cobertura sobre la inteligencia artificial {{c1::eclipsó}} el conflicto laboral, aunque miles de trabajadores seguían afrontando despidos inminentes.
note: The source is polysemous. This note selects the reduced-salience sense and materially refines old_back, which is better for making an atmosphere or achievement gloomy.

register: Neutral-analytical for keeping connected concerns or areas in separate mental, institutional or informational compartments.
trap: In the cognitive sense, compartimentar deliberately isolates related issues in separate compartments; the broader dividir does not by itself express that psychological framing.
example_tl: La investigación sostiene que los directivos compartimentaron mentalmente sus responsabilidades éticas y financieras para presentar cada decisión como un asunto puramente técnico.
example_en: The investigation argues that the executives compartmentalised their ethical and financial responsibilities mentally to present each decision as a purely technical matter.
cloze: La investigación sostiene que los directivos {{c1::compartimentaron}} mentalmente sus responsabilidades éticas y financieras para presentar cada decisión como un asunto puramente técnico.
note: Old_back is a valid core equivalent, but the example fixes the cognitive sense rather than the more literal division of a physical or administrative space.

register: Neutral technical and institutional usage for establishing functional links among systems, datasets or processes.
trap: Spanish uses interconectar two systems or interconectar one system con another; the governed con frame should not be replaced by an English-style bare juxtaposition.
example_tl: La nueva norma obliga a interconectar los registros públicos con sistemas de verificación, ampliando la trazabilidad sin resolver quién controla esos cruces.
example_en: The new rule requires public registers to be interconnected with verification systems, increasing traceability without resolving who controls those cross-checks.
cloze: La nueva norma obliga a {{c1::interconectar}} los registros públicos {{c1::con}} sistemas de verificación, ampliando la trazabilidad sin resolver quién controla esos cruces.
note: The legacy verb is correct; retention is justified by the productive con frame and the policy distinction between linking systems and merely making them available.

register: Neutral-formal in journalism, history and analysis; it means situating a fact within the framework needed to interpret it.
trap: Contextualizar is more than describe or summarise: it requires identifying the historical, institutional or social frame that gives an event meaning.
example_tl: El análisis contextualiza la crisis energética en el marco de una década de dependencia industrial y decisiones geopolíticas mal calculadas.
example_en: The analysis contextualises the energy crisis within a decade of industrial dependence and poorly calculated geopolitical decisions.
cloze: El análisis {{c1::contextualiza}} la crisis energética en el marco de una década de dependencia industrial y decisiones geopolíticas mal calculadas.
note: The old rendering is accurate. Retention is justified by the established analytical verb and its useful contrast with the less compact phrase poner en contexto.

register: Neutral-formal for departing from a rule, standard, course or previously declared position.
trap: The source sense is normally reflexive and takes de: desviarse de a standard; transitive desviar is used to divert traffic, water or attention.
example_tl: La plataforma se desvió de sus propios criterios de moderación cuando varios gobiernos exigieron retirar contenidos incómodos sin dar explicaciones públicas.
example_en: The platform deviated from its own moderation criteria when several governments demanded the removal of inconvenient content without giving public explanations.
cloze: La plataforma {{c1::se desvió de}} sus propios criterios de moderación cuando varios gobiernos exigieron retirar contenidos incómodos sin dar explicaciones públicas.
note: Materially corrects old_back, which gives transitive desviar and omits both the reflexive marker and the governed de required by the institutional sense.

register: Written media and political usage for an idea, demand or account receiving a meaningful public response; it need not be positive.
trap: Resonar is natural for sounds and can be figurative, but tener eco or encontrar eco is usually the idiomatic choice when a proposal gains public response.
example_tl: La denuncia tuvo eco entre los trabajadores porque vinculaba la precariedad cotidiana con decisiones financieras tomadas lejos de la redacción.
example_en: The denunciation resonated among the workers because it linked everyday insecurity to financial decisions made far from the newsroom.
cloze: La denuncia {{c1::tuvo eco entre}} los trabajadores porque vinculaba la precariedad cotidiana con decisiones financieras tomadas lejos de la redacción.
note: The legacy cognate is possible, but the note selects the idiomatic public-reception frame rather than forcing the source into a positive support verb such as recibir apoyo.

register: Formal in political theory, geopolitics and market analysis; predominio is less theoretical and foregrounds concrete dominance.
trap: Hegemonía denotes sustained predominance or leadership, not merely a majority; its usual domain complement is introduced by sobre.
example_tl: El consorcio consolidó su hegemonía sobre la nube europea mediante adquisiciones que dejaron a los competidores dependientes de sus estándares técnicos.
example_en: The consortium consolidated its hegemony over the European cloud market through acquisitions that left competitors dependent on its technical standards.
cloze: El consorcio consolidó su {{c1::hegemonía sobre}} la nube europea mediante adquisiciones que dejaron a los competidores dependientes de sus estándares técnicos.
note: The legacy noun is accurate; the production headword adds the common complement and fixes the formal geopolitical and market-analysis sense.

register: Neutral-formal in analytical and argumentative prose; the productive frame la paradoja de introduces an apparently contradictory result.
trap: Spanish uses the feminine la paradoja, unlike the masculine forms in Portuguese and Italian; do not transfer their article into Spanish.
example_tl: La paradoja de la economía de plataformas es que una oferta aparentemente ilimitada depende de unas pocas infraestructuras privadas.
example_en: The paradox of the platform economy is that an apparently unlimited supply depends on a few private infrastructures.
cloze: La {{c1::paradoja de}} la economía de plataformas es que una oferta aparentemente ilimitada depende de unas pocas infraestructuras privadas.
note: The legacy rendering is correct. Retention is justified by the cross-language gender trap and the common de-complement in argumentative prose.

register: Formal in constitutional, geopolitical and technology-policy prose; soberanía digital is an established policy extension.
trap: Soberanía is not simply independencia: it foregrounds supreme authority and the capacity to determine rules within a domain.
example_tl: La soberanía digital resulta meramente retórica mientras las administraciones públicas dependan de proveedores extranjeros para almacenar sus datos estratégicos.
example_en: Digital sovereignty remains merely rhetorical while public administrations depend on foreign providers to store their strategic data.
cloze: La {{c1::soberanía}} digital resulta meramente retórica mientras las administraciones públicas dependan de proveedores extranjeros para almacenar sus datos estratégicos.
note: The legacy noun is accurate; retention is justified by the high-value technology-policy collocation and its distinction from the looser concept of independence.

register: Formal and technical for compliance with a standard or requirement; social conformity is normally conformismo or adaptación.
trap: Conformidad means compliance or agreement with a requirement, whereas conformismo describes an uncritical social attitude; the legacy gloss chooses the wrong sense.
example_tl: La autoridad verifica la conformidad del sistema de recomendación con las normas europeas antes de autorizar su despliegue en servicios públicos.
example_en: The authority verifies the recommendation system's conformity with European rules before authorising its deployment in public services.
cloze: La autoridad verifica la {{c1::conformidad}} del sistema de recomendación {{c1::con}} las normas europeas antes de autorizar su despliegue en servicios públicos.
note: Materially corrects old_back: conformismo is an attitude of uncritical conformity, while the source's regulatory sense is conformidad con a rule or standard.

register: Written-neutral in policy, media and linguistic analysis for wording or conduct open to multiple interpretations.
trap: Ambigüedad is not the same as ambivalencia, which concerns mixed feelings, or incertidumbre, which concerns lack of knowledge rather than multiple readings.
example_tl: La ambigüedad estratégica del comunicado permitió a cada Gobierno interpretarlo como una promesa de cooperación o como una advertencia velada.
example_en: The strategic ambiguity of the communiqué allowed each government to interpret it as a promise of cooperation or a veiled warning.
cloze: La {{c1::ambigüedad}} estratégica del comunicado permitió a cada Gobierno interpretarlo como una promesa de cooperación o como una advertencia velada.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate. Retention is justified by the policy collocation ambigüedad estratégica and the distinction from ambivalencia and incertidumbre.

register: Specialist academic, media and organisational vocabulary for the characteristic moral or cultural orientation of a group or institution.
trap: Ethos is masculine and means a collective moral or cultural character; it is narrower than the broad nouns ética or moral and is not a synonym for rules.
example_tl: El ethos de la redacción se erosionó cuando la dirección convirtió la independencia editorial en una variable subordinada a los ingresos publicitarios.
example_en: The newsroom's ethos eroded when management turned editorial independence into a variable subordinate to advertising revenue.
cloze: El {{c1::ethos}} de la redacción se erosionó cuando la dirección convirtió la independencia editorial en una variable subordinada a los ingresos publicitarios.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate. Retention is justified by the specialist term, its masculine article and its distinction from broader ethical vocabulary.

register: Written-analytical and often critical in social, political and media commentary for division into disconnected parts.
trap: Fragmentación is not the same as polarización: it describes multiplication into separate parts, not necessarily opposition between two camps.
example_tl: La fragmentación de la esfera pública dificulta cualquier deliberación común, porque cada grupo consume información dentro de circuitos cada vez más cerrados.
example_en: The fragmentation of the public sphere makes shared deliberation difficult because each group consumes information within increasingly closed circuits.
cloze: La {{c1::fragmentación}} de la esfera pública dificulta cualquier deliberación común, porque cada grupo consume información dentro de circuitos cada vez más cerrados.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate. Retention is justified by the critical media collocation and the semantic distinction from polarización; the related verb was dropped as redundant.

alts: la conversión de algo en mercancía
register: Specialist and critical in sociology, political economy and media analysis for turning something into a tradable commodity.
trap: Comercialización means marketing or putting something on sale; it does not necessarily express the conversion into a commodity marked by mercantilización.
example_tl: La mercantilización de la atención convierte cada interacción cotidiana en un activo medible que las plataformas pueden vender a anunciantes.
example_en: The commodification of attention turns every everyday interaction into a measurable asset that platforms can sell to advertisers.
cloze: La {{c1::mercantilización}} de la atención convierte cada interacción cotidiana en un activo medible que las plataformas pueden vender a anunciantes.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate. Retention is justified by the marked critical term and its important distinction from the broader comercialización.

register: Neutral-formal in media and political commentary for perceived genuineness of a person, voice or performance.
trap: Autenticidad concerns genuineness or an apparently genuine voice, while veracidad concerns whether a claim is true; the two are not interchangeable.
example_tl: La autenticidad performativa de los candidatos en redes se construye mediante escenas espontáneas cuidadosamente guionizadas para cada segmento de audiencia.
example_en: The performative authenticity of candidates on social media is constructed through carefully scripted spontaneous scenes for each audience segment.
cloze: La {{c1::autenticidad}} performativa de los candidatos en redes se construye mediante escenas espontáneas cuidadosamente guionizadas para cada segmento de audiencia.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate. Retention is justified by the critical media collocation and the distinction between an authentic persona and the truth of a statement.

register: Specialist but standard in technical regulation and digital policy for systems that can exchange and use information across boundaries.
trap: Compatibilidad is not automatically interoperabilidad: compatible systems may coexist without being able to exchange and process one another's data.
example_tl: La interoperabilidad entre servicios de mensajería permitiría cambiar de proveedor sin perder contactos, historiales ni la posibilidad de comunicarse con otros usuarios.
example_en: Interoperability between messaging services would allow users to change providers without losing contacts, histories or the ability to communicate with others.
cloze: La {{c1::interoperabilidad entre}} servicios de mensajería permitiría cambiar de proveedor sin perder contactos, historiales ni la posibilidad de comunicarse con otros usuarios.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate. Retention is justified by the precise regulatory meaning and its consequential distinction from mere compatibility.

register: Written-formal in media theory and criticism for an apparently direct, unmediated experience or relationship.
trap: In this media-theoretical sense, inmediatez means lack of mediation or distance, not urgency; urgency is urgencia or premura.
example_tl: La aparente inmediatez de las retransmisiones en directo oculta las decisiones editoriales y técnicas que moldean cada imagen antes de llegar al público.
example_en: The apparent immediacy of live broadcasts conceals the editorial and technical decisions that shape each image before it reaches the public.
cloze: La aparente {{c1::inmediatez}} de las retransmisiones en directo oculta las decisiones editoriales y técnicas que moldean cada imagen antes de llegar al público.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate for the media-theoretical sense fixed here; retention guards against reading the noun as urgency.

register: Neutral-formal in social science and media analysis for a process through which previously diverse objects or practices become more uniform.
trap: Homogeneización can describe an emergent structural process; estandarización or normalización more specifically foregrounds a deliberate act of setting a common standard.
example_tl: La homogeneización de los medios regionales avanza cuando los mismos algoritmos de recomendación premian idénticos formatos y ritmos narrativos.
example_en: The homogenisation of regional media advances when the same recommendation algorithms reward identical formats and narrative rhythms.
cloze: La {{c1::homogeneización}} de los medios regionales avanza cuando los mismos algoritmos de recomendación premian idénticos formatos y ritmos narrativos.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate. Retention is justified by the social-analysis process noun and the distinction between emergent homogenisation and deliberate standard-setting.

tl: la dicotomía entre algo y algo
alts: la división binaria entre algo y algo
register: Formal-analytical in political theory, media commentary and technology criticism; it presents two opposed categories or options.
trap: Dichotomía means a strong two-way division, not any simple difference; dualidad can be broader and does not necessarily imply opposition.
example_tl: La dicotomía entre seguridad y libertad reaparece cada vez que los Gobiernos regulan plataformas capaces de perfilar a millones de ciudadanos.
example_en: The dichotomy between security and freedom resurfaces whenever governments regulate platforms capable of profiling millions of citizens.
cloze: La {{c1::dicotomía entre}} seguridad y libertad reaparece cada vez que los Gobiernos regulan plataformas capaces de perfilar a millones de ciudadanos.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate. Retention is justified by the productive entre frame and the distinction from a merely neutral difference.

register: Learned formal vocabulary in technology, media and social analysis for presence across virtually every place or context.
trap: Ubicuidad is not ubicación: it means being everywhere, while ubicación refers to a location; estar omnipresente is often more idiomatic in a finite clause.
example_tl: La ubicuidad de los sistemas de recomendación normaliza una vigilancia discreta que ya no depende de una decisión consciente del usuario.
example_en: The ubiquity of recommendation systems normalises a discreet form of surveillance that no longer depends on a conscious user decision.
cloze: La {{c1::ubicuidad de}} los sistemas de recomendación normaliza una vigilancia discreta que ya no depende de una decisión consciente del usuario.
note: The old rendering is correct but unusually learned. Retention is justified by the term's high-value technology-policy use and its contrast with ubicación.

tl: la disparidad entre algo y algo
alts: la brecha entre algo y algo
register: Formal policy and social-science vocabulary for a marked inequality between groups, regions, resources or outcomes.
trap: Disparidad denotes an unequal degree or distribution, not just any diferencia; brecha is vivid and common but can imply a more measurable gap.
example_tl: La disparidad entre las regiones conectadas y las zonas rurales persiste, aunque los Gobiernos anuncien cobertura digital casi universal.
example_en: The disparity between connected regions and rural areas persists, even though governments announce almost universal digital coverage.
cloze: La {{c1::disparidad entre}} las regiones conectadas y las zonas rurales persiste, aunque los Gobiernos anuncien cobertura digital casi universal.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate. Retention is justified by the productive entre frame and the distinction between a structural disparity and an ordinary difference.

register: Formal written usage in public policy, security and media analysis for rapid spread or multiplication of things, often with a critical implication.
trap: Proliferación suggests multiplication or unchecked spread, not merely gradual crecimiento; Spanish takes the de complement for what proliferates.
example_tl: La proliferación de medios sintéticos dificulta atribuir responsabilidades cuando una campaña de desinformación cruza varias jurisdicciones en pocas horas.
example_en: The proliferation of synthetic media makes it difficult to assign responsibility when a disinformation campaign crosses several jurisdictions in a few hours.
cloze: La {{c1::proliferación de}} medios sintéticos dificulta atribuir responsabilidades cuando una campaña de desinformación cruza varias jurisdicciones en pocas horas.
note: The old rendering is accurate. Retention is justified by the formal process noun, its de government and its stronger sense of unchecked multiplication than simple growth.

register: Critical technology and institutional metaphor for dependence on one dominant architecture, supplier or way of thinking.
trap: Monocultura can describe cultural uniformity, while monocultivo is literal agriculture; monocultivo tecnológico is the established figurative alternative in tech criticism.
example_tl: La monocultura tecnológica vuelve frágiles las cadenas de suministro porque un fallo en un proveedor puede paralizar servicios esenciales.
example_en: Technological monoculture makes supply chains fragile because a failure at one provider can paralyse essential services.
cloze: La {{c1::monocultura tecnológica}} vuelve frágiles las cadenas de suministro porque un fallo en un proveedor puede paralizar servicios esenciales.
note: The legacy monocultivo is possible, especially in the technology metaphor. The note selects monocultura as the broader institutional headword and records the useful alternative.

register: Formal philosophical and political-analysis vocabulary for the fact that an outcome is possible but not necessary or predetermined.
trap: Contingencia also means an unforeseen event or emergency plan; the abstract sense here concerns non-necessity, not a plan de contingencia.
example_tl: La contingencia de las fronteras políticas queda patente cuando una crisis energética obliga a renegociar alianzas consideradas permanentes.
example_en: The contingency of political borders becomes clear when an energy crisis forces alliances considered permanent to be renegotiated.
cloze: La {{c1::contingencia de}} las fronteras políticas queda patente cuando una crisis energética obliga a renegociar alianzas consideradas permanentes.
note: The old rendering is accurate but underspecified. Self-review selected the theoretical sense and explicitly separated it from the common emergency and backup-plan senses.

tl: el avance progresivo de algo sobre algo
register: Formal critical vocabulary for a gradual extension into another actor's territory, rights, sphere or institutional remit.
trap: Encroachment is gradual expansion into a domain; invasión alone can suggest an abrupt military attack and is too strong without the gradual qualifier.
example_tl: El avance progresivo de la vigilancia privada sobre el espacio público altera las fronteras entre seguridad legítima y control social.
example_en: The progressive encroachment of private surveillance into public space alters the boundaries between legitimate security and social control.
cloze: El {{c1::avance progresivo de}} la vigilancia privada sobre el espacio público altera las fronteras entre seguridad legítima y control social.
note: Materially refines old_back: invasión is possible but too abrupt and military for the source's gradual institutional-expansion sense.

register: Formal technical and abstract usage for the ease with which a material, rule, identity or institution can be reshaped.
trap: Maleabilidad is the capacity to be shaped, not simply adaptability or convenience; flexibilidad is broader and can omit the idea of imposed reshaping.
example_tl: La maleabilidad de las normas digitales permite a las plataformas reinterpretarlas según sus intereses, debilitando cualquier límite democrático efectivo.
example_en: The malleability of digital rules allows platforms to reinterpret them according to their interests, weakening any effective democratic limit.
cloze: La {{c1::maleabilidad de}} las normas digitales permite a las plataformas reinterpretarlas según sus intereses, debilitando cualquier límite democrático efectivo.
note: The legacy rendering is correct. Retention is justified by the abstract governance collocation and the distinction from the broader flexibilidad.

register: Specialist philosophical vocabulary for judging actions primarily by their consequences rather than by duties or intrinsic rules.
trap: Consecuencialismo is broader than utilitarismo: utilitarianism is one consequentialist theory, not a direct synonym for the whole category.
example_tl: El consecuencialismo puede justificar una medida impopular si sus efectos agregados reducen el daño, aunque vulnere una expectativa de justicia.
example_en: Consequentialism can justify an unpopular measure if its aggregate effects reduce harm, even if it violates an expectation of justice.
cloze: El {{c1::consecuencialismo}} puede justificar una medida impopular si sus efectos agregados reducen el daño, aunque vulnere una expectativa de justicia.
note: The old rendering is accurate. Retention is justified by the specialist ethics term and its important distinction from the narrower utilitarianism.

register: Formal social-theory and political vocabulary for a state whose boundaries, identities or affiliations remain mobile rather than fixed.
trap: In this abstract sense fluidez means mobility or lack of fixed boundaries, not fluidez verbal; volatilidad suggests instability rather than flexible identity.
example_tl: La fluidez de las identidades políticas se hace visible cuando los votantes combinan demandas incompatibles sin adoptar una afiliación estable.
example_en: The fluidity of political identities becomes visible when voters combine incompatible demands without adopting a stable affiliation.
cloze: La {{c1::fluidez de}} las identidades políticas se hace visible cuando los votantes combinan demandas incompatibles sin adoptar una afiliación estable.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate. The example fixes the social-theory sense rather than the more ordinary sense of fluent speech or liquid flow.

register: Learned but established vocabulary in research, journalism and cultural commentary for a valuable discovery made unexpectedly.
trap: Serendipia is not just suerte: it combines chance with recognising the value of an unexpected finding, and it is feminine in Spanish.
example_tl: La serendipia científica depende de archivos accesibles y de investigadores capaces de reconocer una anomalía que el protocolo no había previsto.
example_en: Scientific serendipity depends on accessible archives and researchers able to recognise an anomaly that the protocol had not anticipated.
cloze: La {{c1::serendipia científica}} depende de archivos accesibles y de investigadores capaces de reconocer una anomalía que el protocolo no había previsto.
note: The old rendering is accurate. Retention is justified by the established but marked research term and its stronger meaning than accidental luck alone.

tl: la permeabilidad de algo a algo
register: Formal technical and metaphorical vocabulary for how readily a boundary, material or institution allows something to pass through or exert influence.
trap: The usual complement is introduced by a: permeabilidad de una frontera a la influencia; do not transfer Portuguese or Italian prepositions mechanically.
example_tl: La permeabilidad de las fronteras digitales a la influencia extranjera complica la atribución de campañas coordinadas de manipulación informativa.
example_en: The permeability of digital borders to foreign influence complicates attribution of coordinated information-manipulation campaigns.
cloze: La {{c1::permeabilidad de las fronteras digitales a}} la influencia extranjera complica la atribución de campañas coordinadas de manipulación informativa.
note: The old rendering is correct but omits the productive complement. Self-review added the de algo a algo frame to make the abstract metaphor usable.

register: Neutral-formal technical and statistical vocabulary for combining separate observations into a dataset or summary.
trap: Agregación can mean adding or grouping; in data policy it is neither data collection nor anonymisation, although aggregation may reduce exposure.
example_tl: La agregación de datos permite comparar tendencias regionales sin exponer cada registro individual, siempre que el diseño preserve los límites de reidentificación.
example_en: Data aggregation makes it possible to compare regional trends without exposing each individual record, provided the design preserves re-identification limits.
cloze: La {{c1::agregación de datos}} permite comparar tendencias regionales sin exponer cada registro individual, siempre que el diseño preserve los límites de reidentificación.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate. Retention is justified by the established data-policy collocation and its distinction from collection, addition and anonymisation.

tl: la reciprocidad entre algo y algo
register: Formal diplomatic, institutional and social-science vocabulary for mutual exchange of rights, concessions, obligations or benefits.
trap: Reciprocidad is mutuality with an exchange or condition, not mere cooperación or symmetry; the common relational frame uses entre.
example_tl: La reciprocidad entre concesiones comerciales y garantías de seguridad sostiene el acuerdo, aunque ninguna parte confíe plenamente en la otra.
example_en: Reciprocity between trade concessions and security guarantees sustains the agreement, although neither side fully trusts the other.
cloze: La {{c1::reciprocidad entre}} concesiones comerciales y garantías de seguridad sostiene el acuerdo, aunque ninguna parte confíe plenamente en la otra.
note: The old rendering is accurate. Retention is justified by the diplomatic concept, its entre frame and the distinction from generic cooperation.

tl: el intermediario entre algo y algo
alts: la entidad intermediaria entre algo y algo
register: Neutral-formal economic, institutional and media vocabulary for a person or organisation connecting two parties or markets.
trap: Intermediario is a noun for a go-between, not the adjective intermedio; mediador is narrower and often implies resolving a dispute.
example_tl: El intermediario entre anunciantes y medios condiciona el mercado porque controla los datos necesarios para medir cada audiencia.
example_en: The intermediary between advertisers and media outlets shapes the market because it controls the data needed to measure each audience.
cloze: El {{c1::intermediario entre}} anunciantes y medios condiciona el mercado porque controla los datos necesarios para medir cada audiencia.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate. Retention is justified by the productive entre frame and the distinction between an intermediary and a dispute mediator.

register: Established formal policy vocabulary for the structures, processes and accountability arrangements through which a domain is steered.
trap: Gobernanza is not simply gobierno: it includes distributed decision-making, rules and accountability among public and private actors.
example_tl: La gobernanza de la inteligencia artificial exige repartir responsabilidades entre empresas, reguladores y comunidades afectadas por sus decisiones.
example_en: The governance of artificial intelligence requires distributing responsibility among companies, regulators and communities affected by its decisions.
cloze: La {{c1::gobernanza de}} la inteligencia artificial exige repartir responsabilidades entre empresas, reguladores y comunidades afectadas por sus decisiones.
note: The old rendering is correct. Retention is justified by the policy concept and its crucial distinction from government as an institution.

register: Technology and organisational metaphor for information or work isolated from other systems, teams or departments.
trap: Silo is literal agricultural vocabulary as well as a productive data metaphor; compartimento estanco is often more idiomatic for organisational isolation.
example_tl: Los silos de datos impiden que las administraciones detecten patrones comunes, aunque cada departamento disponga de indicadores técnicamente impecables.
example_en: Data silos prevent administrations from detecting common patterns, even though each department has technically impeccable indicators.
cloze: Los {{c1::silos de datos}} impiden que las administraciones detecten patrones comunes, aunque cada departamento disponga de indicadores técnicamente impecables.
note: The legacy headword is literally correct but underspecified. Retention is justified by the established organisational and data-architecture metaphor.

register: Critical sociological and media vocabulary for a culture or ideology that treats continual consumption as a social good or personal obligation.
trap: Consumismo is not neutral consumo and is distinct from consumerismo, which can refer to consumer advocacy; it usually carries criticism.
example_tl: El consumismo convierte la renovación constante de dispositivos en una obligación social, incluso cuando la obsolescencia responde a decisiones de diseño deliberadas.
example_en: Consumerism turns the constant replacement of devices into a social obligation, even when obsolescence results from deliberate design decisions.
cloze: El {{c1::consumismo}} convierte la renovación constante de dispositivos en una obligación social, incluso cuando la obsolescencia responde a decisiones de diseño deliberadas.
note: The old rendering is accurate. Retention is justified by the critical consumption-centered sense and its distinction from neutral consumption or consumer advocacy.

alts: el poder de las grandes empresas
register: Rare critical political vocabulary for a system in which large corporations exert decisive power over public institutions or policy.
trap: Corporatocracia is not corporativismo: the former suggests rule or dominance by corporations, while the latter concerns organised interest groups and corporative structures.
example_tl: La corporatocracia no se impone solo mediante leyes favorables: también moldea los criterios técnicos con los que se evalúa el interés público.
example_en: Corporatocracy is imposed not only through favourable laws: it also shapes the technical criteria used to assess the public interest.
cloze: La {{c1::corporatocracia}} no se impone solo mediante leyes favorables: también moldea los criterios técnicos con los que se evalúa el interés público.
