trap: Spanish distributes this English verb across collocations: vulnerar un derecho, infringir una norma and incumplir un contrato are often more precise than generic violar.
example_tl: La aplicación vulneró el derecho a la intimidad al activar el micrófono sin permiso y conservar grabaciones que no eran necesarias.
example_en: The application violated the right to privacy by activating the microphone without permission and retaining recordings that were not necessary.
cloze: La aplicación {{c1::vulneró el derecho}} a la intimidad al activar el micrófono sin permiso y conservar grabaciones que no eran necesarias.
note: Materially narrows the polysemous prompt to violation of a right; legacy violar is possible here but conceals useful professional collocations.

register: Neutral in economics, policy and general usage; con is often less adversarial than contra when naming the competitor.
trap: Keep the complements distinct: an actor competes con or contra a rival, por a contract or prize, and en a market or sector.
example_tl: Las empresas europeas compiten con conglomerados asiáticos por contratos públicos, pero carecen del capital paciente necesario para sostener proyectos estratégicos.
example_en: European companies compete with Asian conglomerates for public contracts, but lack the patient capital needed to sustain strategic projects.
cloze: Las empresas europeas {{c1::compiten}} {{c1::con}} conglomerados asiáticos {{c1::por}} contratos públicos, pero carecen del capital paciente necesario para sostener proyectos estratégicos.
note: The legacy lemma is accurate; the production headword and example supply two complementary prepositions that the bare infinitive does not teach.

register: Neutral-formal and idiomatic in policy and analytical prose; afrontar often suggests confronting a particularly difficult problem.
trap: Address is sense-dependent: abordar or tratar una cuestión means deal with it, whereas dirigir is used for directing words or correspondence.
example_tl: La propuesta aborda el problema de la moderación automatizada, pero omite explicar cómo podrán los usuarios impugnar decisiones erróneas o arbitrarias.
example_en: The proposal addresses the problem of automated moderation, but fails to explain how users will be able to challenge erroneous or arbitrary decisions.
cloze: La propuesta {{c1::aborda el problema}} de la moderación automatizada, pero omite explicar cómo podrán los usuarios impugnar decisiones erróneas o arbitrarias.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate for the deal-with-an-issue sense selected here.

register: Neutral-formal in political economy and institutional analysis when an action makes an existing position or power structure more firmly established.
trap: Legacy atrincherarse is reflexive and depicts an actor taking refuge or stubbornly holding a position; it does not express transitively entrenching power or inequality.
example_tl: La compra afianzó el poder del proveedor dominante al integrar datos, publicidad e infraestructura en un ecosistema difícil de abandonar.
example_en: The acquisition entrenched the dominant provider's power by integrating data, advertising and infrastructure into an ecosystem that was difficult to leave.
cloze: La compra {{c1::afianzó}} el poder del proveedor dominante al integrar datos, publicidad e infraestructura en un ecosistema difícil de abandonar.
note: Materially replaces old_back atrincherarse, whose reflexive argument structure and defensive image mistranslate the transitive institutional sense.

register: Neutral-formal in political and regulatory reporting; hacer lobby is common but more visibly anglicized, while cabildear is especially frequent in the Americas.
trap: Spanish has no single neutral verb matching every use of lobby; in formal Spain-oriented prose, prefer ejercer presión sobre or describe the lobbying activity.
example_tl: Las plataformas ejercieron presión sobre varios diputados para suavizar la norma, mientras asociaciones civiles hacían públicas las reuniones celebradas a puerta cerrada.
example_en: The platforms lobbied several members of parliament to weaken the rules, while civil-society associations disclosed the meetings held behind closed doors.
cloze: Las plataformas {{c1::ejercieron presión sobre}} varios diputados para suavizar la norma, mientras asociaciones civiles hacían públicas las reuniones celebradas a puerta cerrada.
note: Legacy presionar is valid, but the selected construction better names sustained influence activity and makes its sobre complement explicit. Self-review replaced publicaban las reuniones with idiomatic hacían públicas las reuniones.

register: Neutral in business, institutional and project contexts for entering a collaborative relationship; a more specific agreement may require colaborar or aliarse.
trap: The partnership sense is reflexive and governs con: asociarse con una entidad. Non-reflexive asociar una cosa con otra means to connect ideas or things.
example_tl: La operadora se asoció con una universidad pública para auditar sus algoritmos, pero la empresa se reservó la decisión final sobre los cambios.
example_en: The operator partnered with a public university to audit its algorithms, but the company reserved the final decision on changes for itself.
cloze: La operadora {{c1::se asoció con}} una universidad pública para auditar sus algoritmos, pero la empresa se reservó la decisión final sobre los cambios.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate; the production headword preserves the obligatory reflexive marker and governed preposition. Self-review made the second clause reflexive to clarify which party retained final authority.

register: Neutral for successfully obtaining funding, a contract, support or access; obtener is slightly more formal in institutional prose.
trap: Do not default to asegurar: it usually means to ensure, protect or fasten, whereas securing funding or a contract is conseguirlo or obtenerlo.
example_tl: El consorcio consiguió financiación europea para ampliar la red, aunque deberá demostrar que los nuevos nodos reducen realmente la brecha territorial.
example_en: The consortium secured European funding to expand the network, although it will have to show that the new nodes genuinely reduce the regional divide.
cloze: El consorcio {{c1::consiguió}} financiación europea para ampliar la red, aunque deberá demostrar que los nuevos nodos reducen realmente la brecha territorial.
note: The English prompt is polysemous. This note selects the obtain-successfully sense and materially replaces legacy asegurar, which normally points to a different sense.

register: Neutral-critical for tracking, interfaces and practices that improperly intrude on privacy; invasivo is also used figuratively but remains prominent in medical contexts.
trap: In privacy criticism, intrusivo often captures unwanted intrusion more precisely; invasivo is not wrong, but its strongest established associations are medical and biological.
example_tl: El seguimiento intrusivo convierte cada interacción en una señal comercial, incluso cuando el usuario rechaza cookies y limita los permisos de la aplicación.
example_en: Invasive tracking turns every interaction into a commercial signal, even when the user rejects cookies and restricts the application's permissions.
cloze: El seguimiento {{c1::intrusivo}} convierte cada interacción en una señal comercial, incluso cuando el usuario rechaza cookies y limita los permisos de la aplicación.
note: Materially refines legacy invasivo by selecting the privacy-practice sense; the legacy cognate remains a possible alternative rather than a universal equivalent.

register: Neutral for actors or institutions possessing substantial power; influyente emphasizes influence, while potente normally modifies machines, drugs, arguments or other high-capacity things.
trap: Choose by referent: a powerful regulator is poderoso, but a powerful computer is potente; legacy potente cannot serve as the default equivalent.
example_tl: Un regulador poderoso puede exigir acceso a los modelos, pero necesita independencia política para sancionar a empresas capaces de dilatar indefinidamente las investigaciones.
example_en: A powerful regulator can demand access to the models, but needs political independence to sanction companies capable of dragging investigations out indefinitely.
cloze: Un regulador {{c1::poderoso}} puede exigir acceso a los modelos, pero necesita independencia política para sancionar a empresas capaces de dilatar indefinidamente las investigaciones.
note: The prompt is polysemous. This note selects institutional power and materially replaces legacy potente, which suits a different class of referents. Self-review replaced the generic retrasar with the more idiomatic dilatar las investigaciones.

register: Neutral-critical; poco ético is idiomatic and can sound less categorical than inmoral, while contrario a la ética is more explicit and formal.
trap: English un- does not map mechanically to a Spanish negative prefix here: poco ético and antiético are established, whereas inmoral can express a stronger judgment.
example_tl: Resulta poco ético experimentar con usuarios vulnerables sin informarles de los riesgos ni ofrecerles una vía sencilla para retirar su consentimiento.
example_en: It is unethical to experiment on vulnerable users without informing them of the risks or offering them a simple way to withdraw consent.
cloze: Resulta {{c1::poco ético}} experimentar con usuarios vulnerables sin informarles de los riesgos ni ofrecerles una vía sencilla para retirar su consentimiento.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate; the note records its pragmatic force and distinguishes it from the stronger inmoral.

register: Neutral-formal for an activity, market or arrangement that produces substantial profit; rentable has broader business and cost-effectiveness uses.
trap: Lucrativo concerns profit, not revenue alone; a high-revenue activity may still be unprofitable once its costs are taken into account.
example_tl: El mercado de datos biométricos resulta lucrativo para intermediarios opacos, aunque las personas cuyos rasgos se registran rara vez participan en los beneficios.
example_en: The biometric-data market is lucrative for opaque intermediaries, although the people whose features are recorded rarely share in the profits.
cloze: El mercado de datos biométricos resulta {{c1::lucrativo}} para intermediarios opacos, aunque las personas cuyos rasgos se registran rara vez participan en los beneficios.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate; retention is justified by the useful contrast between profit-producing lucrativo and broader rentable. Self-review clarified that biometric features, rather than people as registry entries, are recorded.

register: Neutral-critical in research, media and algorithmic analysis; parcial can emphasize lack of neutrality but may also simply mean incomplete.
trap: Portuguese enviesado and French biaisé do not transfer morphologically into Spanish; a biased model, sample or account is normally sesgado.
example_tl: El informe ofrecía un diagnóstico sesgado porque excluía a trabajadores subcontratados y presentaba como universales las experiencias de la plantilla fija.
example_en: The report offered a biased diagnosis because it excluded subcontracted workers and presented the experiences of permanent staff as universal.
cloze: El informe ofrecía un diagnóstico {{c1::sesgado}} porque excluía a trabajadores subcontratados y presentaba como universales las experiencias de la plantilla fija.
note: The legacy adjective is lexically correct but appears in an arbitrary feminine form; the production headword restores the conventional masculine singular lemma.

register: Neutral-formal for an analysis, review or account that covers the relevant material thoroughly; integral often emphasizes whole-system scope.
trap: English comprehensive is not normally comprensivo in this collocation: a comprehensive audit is exhaustiva or integral, while a comprensiva person is understanding.
example_tl: La comisión encargó una auditoría exhaustiva del sistema para determinar quién podía modificar el modelo, acceder a los registros y autorizar excepciones.
example_en: The commission ordered a comprehensive audit of the system to determine who could modify the model, access the records and authorize exceptions.
cloze: La comisión encargó una auditoría {{c1::exhaustiva}} del sistema para determinar quién podía modificar el modelo, acceder a los registros y autorizar excepciones.
note: The source adjective is context-sensitive. This note selects thorough coverage for an audit and retains legacy integral as a scope-oriented alternative.

register: Neutral for a person or institution willing to consider concerns or evidence; for responsive web design, Spain-oriented technical prose prefers adaptativo.
trap: Sensible a can fit this human or institutional sense, but legacy sensible without a complement is not a general equivalent; responsivo is avoidable in Spain-oriented prose.
example_tl: El regulador se mostró receptivo a las objeciones de los investigadores, pero exigió pruebas independientes antes de modificar el protocolo de auditoría.
example_en: The regulator was responsive to the researchers' objections, but demanded independent evidence before changing the audit protocol.
cloze: El regulador se mostró {{c1::receptivo a}} las objeciones de los investigadores, pero exigió pruebas independientes antes de modificar el protocolo de auditoría.
note: The isolated prompt is polysemous. This note selects responsiveness to representations or evidence; software and interface contexts require adaptativo or a context-specific verbal rendering.

register: Neutral for an emotionally uninvolved manner, voice or person; frío is more openly critical, while desapasionado may positively suggest objectivity.
trap: Legacy independiente means independent, not emotionally detached; physical separation instead calls for separado, aislado or, for housing, independiente or unifamiliar.
example_tl: El portavoz mantuvo un tono distante durante la comparecencia, incluso cuando las víctimas describieron cómo la filtración había condicionado sus vidas.
example_en: The spokesperson maintained a detached tone during the hearing, even when the victims described how the leak had affected their lives.
cloze: El portavoz mantuvo un tono {{c1::distante}} durante la comparecencia, incluso cuando las víctimas describieron cómo la filtración había condicionado sus vidas.
note: The prompt is strongly polysemous. This note selects emotional detachment and materially replaces legacy independiente, which belongs only to some physical or institutional contexts.

register: Specialist hydrological and environmental terminology; most often encountered in the fixed collocation uso consuntivo, especially of water.
trap: Consuntivo means that a resource is consumed or made unavailable; consumista instead means consumerist and does not translate this technical sense.
example_tl: El ministerio subestimó el uso consuntivo de agua del nuevo centro de datos, cuyo sistema de refrigeración devuelve muy poco caudal.
example_en: The ministry underestimated the new data center's consumptive water use, as its cooling system returns very little flow.
cloze: El ministerio subestimó el uso {{c1::consuntivo}} de agua del nuevo centro de datos, cuyo sistema de refrigeración devuelve muy poco caudal.
note: The legacy rendering is correct only in this specialized resource-use sense; the bare English adjective can require different translations elsewhere. Self-review made the example project-specific to avoid a sweeping claim about all data centers.

register: Neutral across technical, research and policy prose; singular el dato refers to one datum or individual piece of information.
trap: English data often behaves as a mass noun, but datos is normally plural in Spanish and requires plural determiners, adjectives and verbs.
example_tl: Los datos recopilados por la plataforma revelan patrones laborales sensibles, pero la empresa se niega a explicar quién puede consultarlos.
example_en: The data collected by the platform reveal sensitive employment patterns, but the company refuses to explain who may access them.
cloze: {{c1::Los datos}} recopilados por la plataforma revelan patrones laborales sensibles, pero la empresa se niega a explicar quién puede consultarlos.
note: The legacy headword is accurate; retention is justified by the English mass-noun versus Spanish plural agreement contrast.

register: Neutral-formal for the regulation of an activity or market; normativa denotes the applicable body of rules, while reglamento can name a specific instrument.
trap: English regulation may denote a process, an entire framework or one rule; Spanish distinguishes regulación, normativa and reglamento according to that scope.
example_tl: La regulación de los mercados digitales será ineficaz si las autoridades carecen de personal técnico para investigar sistemas algorítmicos opacos.
example_en: Regulation of digital markets will be ineffective if the authorities lack technical staff to investigate opaque algorithmic systems.
cloze: {{c1::La regulación}} de los mercados digitales será ineficaz si las autoridades carecen de personal técnico para investigar sistemas algorítmicos opacos.
note: The legacy rendering is correct for the process or framework sense selected here, but not for every count use of English regulation.

register: Neutral; the shorter anuncio is usually sufficient when the advertising context is already clear.
trap: Publicidad normally denotes advertising as an activity or mass of promotional material; one countable advertisement is un anuncio, not una publicidad in standard European Spanish.
example_tl: El anuncio publicitario omitía las condiciones del servicio y destacaba beneficios que la empresa nunca había demostrado ante los reguladores.
example_en: The advertisement omitted the service conditions and highlighted benefits that the company had never demonstrated to regulators.
cloze: {{c1::El anuncio publicitario}} omitía las condiciones del servicio y destacaba beneficios que la empresa nunca había demostrado ante los reguladores.
note: Materially replaces legacy la publicidad, which changes one countable advertisement into advertising in general. Self-review replaced an awkward claim that the advertisement hid terms behind an interface.

register: Neutral in financial and business reporting; facturación is appropriate when the figure specifically represents invoiced turnover.
trap: Ingresos is normally plural and denotes revenue before costs; beneficios are profits after relevant costs, so the two are not interchangeable.
example_tl: Los ingresos publicitarios crecieron durante el trimestre, aunque la plataforma perdió usuarios activos y afrontó nuevas sanciones por prácticas anticompetitivas.
example_en: Advertising revenue grew during the quarter, although the platform lost active users and faced new penalties for anticompetitive practices.
cloze: {{c1::Los ingresos}} publicitarios crecieron durante el trimestre, aunque la plataforma perdió usuarios activos y afrontó nuevas sanciones por prácticas anticompetitivas.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate; the note retains the plural production pattern and the revenue-versus-profit distinction.

register: Neutral-formal in economics and competition law for rivalry among market participants.
trap: Outside the market sense, English competition may be una competición or un concurso; competencia can also mean competence or legal authority.
example_tl: La autoridad concluyó que la adquisición reduciría la competencia en el mercado publicitario y agravaría la dependencia de los editores pequeños respecto de la plataforma resultante.
example_en: The authority concluded that the acquisition would reduce competition in the advertising market and worsen small publishers' dependence on the resulting platform.
cloze: La autoridad concluyó que la adquisición reduciría {{c1::la competencia}} en el mercado publicitario y agravaría la dependencia de los editores pequeños respecto de la plataforma resultante.
note: The legacy rendering is correct for the economic rivalry sense selected here; the isolated English noun does not select that sense by itself. Self-review made the object of the publishers' dependence explicit.

register: Neutral technical and journalistic terminology for a security compromise; the affected asset can be specified when useful.
trap: Breach is complement-sensitive: a security breach is una brecha de seguridad, but breach of contract is incumplimiento de contrato and breach of a right is vulneración.
example_tl: La brecha de seguridad expuso historiales médicos de miles de pacientes porque el proveedor había ignorado varias alertas internas durante meses.
example_en: The security breach exposed thousands of patients' medical records because the provider had ignored several internal warnings for months.
cloze: {{c1::La brecha de seguridad}} expuso historiales médicos de miles de pacientes porque el proveedor había ignorado varias alertas internas durante meses.
note: The prompt is polysemous. This note selects the security sense; legacy el incumplimiento is valid only for breaches of duties, rules or contracts.

register: Neutral in Spain-oriented financial reporting; ganancia is also standard but can refer more broadly to any gain.
trap: Profit is what remains after relevant costs; ingresos means revenue, while facturación is turnover, so neither is a synonym for beneficio.
example_tl: El beneficio de la empresa aumentó pese al estancamiento de los ingresos, principalmente por los despidos y la reducción del gasto en investigación.
example_en: The company's profit increased despite stagnant revenue, mainly because of layoffs and reduced research spending.
cloze: {{c1::El beneficio}} de la empresa aumentó pese al estancamiento de los ingresos, principalmente por los despidos y la reducción del gasto en investigación.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate; the example deliberately contrasts beneficio with ingresos to fix the intended accounting sense.

register: Neutral in institutional and corporate prose for a coherent policy or approach; directriz and norma suit narrower instructions or rules.
trap: English policy divides among política, directriz and norma by scope; an insurance policy is una póliza, not una política.
example_tl: La política de moderación permite excepciones para dirigentes políticos, pero la empresa no explica qué criterios aplica ni quién autoriza cada decisión.
example_en: The moderation policy allows exceptions for political leaders, but the company does not explain which criteria it applies or who authorizes each decision.
cloze: {{c1::La política}} de moderación permite excepciones para dirigentes políticos, pero la empresa no explica qué criterios aplica ni quién autoriza cada decisión.
note: The legacy rendering is correct for the organizational-policy sense selected here, though it cannot translate every use of the English noun.

tl: la actividad de los grupos de presión
alts: la labor de los grupos de presión
register: Formal and transparent in Spain; cabildeo is established and especially common in the Americas, while the borrowing lobbying remains frequent in journalism.
trap: Legacy los grupos de presión names the actors, not the lobbying activity; the distinction mirrors English lobby group versus lobbying.
example_tl: La actividad de los grupos de presión condicionó la reforma, pues varias plataformas consiguieron reunirse en privado con los diputados antes de que se publicara el borrador.
example_en: Lobbying shaped the reform, as several platforms managed to meet privately with members of parliament before the draft was published.
cloze: {{c1::La actividad de los grupos de presión}} condicionó la reforma, pues varias plataformas consiguieron reunirse en privado con los diputados antes de que se publicara el borrador.
note: Materially expands legacy los grupos de presión to preserve the source's activity-versus-actor distinction. Self-review replaced the unnatural collocation obtener reuniones with conseguir reunirse.

register: Standard formal terminology in governance, public administration and corporate oversight.
trap: Responsabilidad alone omits the institutional duty to explain decisions and answer for them; rendición de cuentas captures that broader governance concept.
example_tl: La rendición de cuentas exige publicar los criterios de recomendación y ofrecer vías de recurso efectivas cuando una decisión automatizada perjudica a un ciudadano.
example_en: Accountability requires publishing the recommendation criteria and providing effective avenues of appeal when an automated decision harms a citizen.
cloze: {{c1::La rendición de cuentas}} exige publicar los criterios de recomendación y ofrecer vías de recurso efectivas cuando una decisión automatizada perjudica a un ciudadano.
note: Materially replaces legacy la responsabilidad, which is too broad to express answerability or the requirement to give an account. Self-review replaced ambiguous recursos efectivos with vías de recurso efectivas.

register: Neutral-formal in administrative, regulatory and project-management prose; interested party is the closest literal back-translation.
trap: A stakeholder is not necessarily an accionista: accionista means shareholder, whereas parte interesada includes any materially affected person or organization.
example_tl: La parte interesada presentó observaciones sobre el protocolo, pero el ministerio solo incorporó aquellas respaldadas por pruebas técnicas verificables.
example_en: The stakeholder submitted comments on the protocol, but the ministry incorporated only those supported by verifiable technical evidence.
cloze: {{c1::La parte interesada}} presentó observaciones sobre el protocolo, pero el ministerio solo incorporó aquellas respaldadas por pruebas técnicas verificables.
note: The legacy concept is correct but was supplied in the plural; the production headword restores the singular number of the English prompt.

register: Neutral-formal in policy, technology and geopolitical analysis; the complement normally identifies the actor, resource or system relied upon.
trap: Use dependencia de or dependencia respecto de, not the English-influenced *dependencia sobre; dependencia can also mean addiction in clinical contexts.
example_tl: La dependencia de proveedores estadounidenses limita la autonomía estratégica europea, especialmente cuando las sanciones impiden actualizar infraestructuras digitales esenciales.
example_en: Dependence on US suppliers limits European strategic autonomy, especially when sanctions prevent essential digital infrastructure from being updated.
cloze: {{c1::La dependencia de}} proveedores estadounidenses limita la autonomía estratégica europea, especialmente cuando las sanciones impiden actualizar infraestructuras digitales esenciales.
note: The legacy rendering gives the correct noun but omits its productive government. This note selects institutional reliance rather than clinical dependence or addiction.

register: Neutral-formal; abogar por is especially natural when publicly supporting a policy, reform, principle or course of action.
trap: Advocar exists only as a dated synonym of abogar; modern standard Spanish uses abogar por, while defender is broader and can also mean protect.
example_tl: La relatora abogó por una moratoria internacional sobre el reconocimiento facial hasta que existieran garantías verificables contra la discriminación algorítmica.
example_en: The rapporteur advocated an international moratorium on facial recognition until verifiable safeguards against algorithmic discrimination were in place.
cloze: La relatora {{c1::abogó por}} una moratoria internacional sobre el reconocimiento facial hasta que existieran garantías verificables contra la discriminación algorítmica.
note: Materially improves on legacy Defender by supplying the conventional verb and its required preposition. Self-review removed the inaccurate implication that advocar is wholly nonexistent.

register: Technical and neutral for assigning a monetary value to an asset; valorar is broader and also covers qualitative assessment.
trap: Appraise is polysemous: tasar suits monetary valuation, whereas evaluar normally concerns quality or performance and valorar can cover either domain.
example_tl: Auditores independientes tasaron los activos digitales de la empresa antes de que el fondo presentara una oferta de adquisición vinculante.
example_en: Independent auditors appraised the company's digital assets before the fund submitted a binding acquisition offer.
cloze: Auditores independientes {{c1::tasaron}} los activos digitales de la empresa antes de que el fondo presentara una oferta de adquisición vinculante.
note: The isolated source is polysemous. This note selects monetary appraisal; legacy valorar remains a valid but less specific alternative.

register: Neutral-formal for putting a position, objection or principle into precise words; suitable for institutional and analytical prose.
trap: Articular is valid when organizing elements into a coherent whole, but it is not always the most natural equivalent for simply stating a concern clearly.
example_tl: La ministra formuló con claridad sus reservas sobre el pacto, sin convertir una discrepancia técnica en una ruptura política irreversible.
example_en: The minister articulated her reservations about the pact clearly, without turning a technical disagreement into an irreversible political rupture.
cloze: La ministra {{c1::formuló con claridad}} sus reservas sobre el pacto, sin convertir una discrepancia técnica en una ruptura política irreversible.
note: The source is context-sensitive. This note selects verbal formulation and narrows the automatic cognate offered by old_back.

register: Neutral for vigorous public support; abanderar is a more rhetorical option, normally used with a cause, reform or movement.
trap: The English verb is not the sports-related Spanish campeonar; championing a cause is defenderla activamente or abanderarla.
example_tl: Varias investigadoras defendieron activamente la ciencia abierta cuando las grandes editoriales intentaron consolidar modelos de acceso todavía más restrictivos.
example_en: Several researchers championed open science when the major publishers tried to consolidate even more restrictive access models.
cloze: Varias investigadoras {{c1::defendieron activamente}} la ciencia abierta cuando las grandes editoriales intentaron consolidar modelos de acceso todavía más restrictivos.
note: Legacy Defender captures generic support but not the vigor associated with champion in this sense; the adverb makes that component explicit.

register: Neutral-formal for considering a possible future action; frequent in policy, legal and business reporting.
trap: Bare contemplar can mean look at something attentively; the frame contemplar la posibilidad de fixes the intended deliberative sense.
example_tl: El Gobierno contempla la posibilidad de suspender las licencias si la empresa vuelve a incumplir las condiciones impuestas por el regulador.
example_en: The government is contemplating suspending the licenses if the company again fails to comply with the conditions imposed by the regulator.
cloze: El Gobierno {{c1::contempla la posibilidad de}} suspender las licencias si la empresa vuelve a incumplir las condiciones impuestas por el regulador.
note: The legacy cognate is valid, but the fuller headword disambiguates deliberate consideration from visual contemplation and supplies the productive construction.

register: Neutral for communicating information, meaning or an impression; the best rendering depends on the kind of content conveyed.
trap: English convey can also mean transport; trasladar suits physical movement, but it is not the default for communicating an impression or message.
example_tl: El gráfico transmite una sensación de estabilidad, aunque excluye los meses en que el precio de la energía aumentó con mayor rapidez.
example_en: The chart conveys a sense of stability, although it excludes the months when energy prices rose most rapidly.
cloze: El gráfico {{c1::transmite}} una sensación de estabilidad, aunque excluye los meses en que el precio de la energía aumentó con mayor rapidez.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate for the communicative sense selected here; the isolated English verb remains polysemous.

register: Written-formal for establishing conceptual, legal or institutional boundaries; common in analytical and regulatory prose.
trap: Delimitar establishes boundaries, whereas limitar restricts scope, quantity or action; the two verbs are related but not interchangeable.
example_tl: El informe delimita las responsabilidades de las plataformas, los anunciantes y las agencias públicas durante una campaña coordinada de desinformación.
example_en: The report delineates the responsibilities of platforms, advertisers and public agencies during a coordinated disinformation campaign.
cloze: El informe {{c1::delimita}} las responsabilidades de las plataformas, los anunciantes y las agencias públicas durante una campaña coordinada de desinformación.
note: The note selects the boundary-setting sense. Legacy delinear is possible, but delimitar is more precise for assigning institutional responsibilities.

register: Neutral-formal for rejecting an objection, explanation or possibility; desestimar is especially common for requests, appeals and claims.
trap: Dismiss is strongly polysemous: despedir means dismiss an employee, while sobreseer can mean dismiss legal proceedings; neither fits an objection here.
example_tl: El comité descartó las objeciones de los expertos sin explicar por qué consideraba suficientes las garantías ofrecidas por el proveedor.
example_en: The committee dismissed the experts' objections without explaining why it considered the safeguards offered by the provider sufficient.
cloze: El comité {{c1::descartó}} las objeciones de los expertos sin explicar por qué consideraba suficientes las garantías ofrecidas por el proveedor.
note: The source is polysemous. This note fixes argumentative rejection; legacy desestimar is a valid alternative in the same example.

register: Formal for contesting the validity of a finding, decision, result or procedure, especially in legal and institutional contexts.
trap: Disputar usually means compete for something or contest possession; it is not the normal verb for formally challenging a decision's validity.
example_tl: La defensa impugnó la validez del peritaje porque la policía había utilizado un programa forense cuya fiabilidad nunca había sido evaluada por un tribunal.
example_en: The defense disputed the validity of the expert report because the police had used forensic software whose reliability had never been assessed by a court.
cloze: La defensa {{c1::impugnó}} la validez del peritaje porque la policía había utilizado un programa forense cuya fiabilidad nunca había sido evaluada por un tribunal.
note: Materially replaces legacy Disputar and selects a formal validity challenge, distinct from the later epistemic question card. Self-review made the judicial assessment idiomatic and explicit.

register: Neutral for accepting a policy, approach or principle; hacer suyo is more rhetorical and emphasizes personal or institutional identification.
trap: Abrazar is possible figuratively, especially with ideas or causes, but adoptar is usually less marked for policies, strategies and technical approaches.
example_tl: El nuevo equipo directivo adoptó una estrategia de interoperabilidad que sus predecesores habían rechazado por considerarla demasiado costosa y políticamente arriesgada.
example_en: The new management team embraced an interoperability strategy that its predecessors had rejected as too costly and politically risky.
cloze: El nuevo equipo directivo {{c1::adoptó}} una estrategia de interoperabilidad que sus predecesores habían rechazado por considerarla demasiado costosa y políticamente arriesgada.
note: The source is polysemous; this note selects acceptance of a strategy rather than literal embrace. Self-review replaced ambiguous ejecutivo with equipo directivo.

register: Written-formal for explaining an argument, doctrine or set of reasons systematically and at some length.
trap: English expound on does not determine a Spanish preposition: Spain-oriented formal prose uses transitive exponer una tesis or intransitive disertar sobre un tema.
example_tl: La jurista expuso detenidamente los fundamentos constitucionales de la propuesta antes de responder a las objeciones planteadas por los grupos parlamentarios.
example_en: The jurist expounded the constitutional grounds for the proposal before responding to the objections raised by the parliamentary groups.
cloze: La jurista {{c1::expuso detenidamente}} los fundamentos constitucionales de la propuesta antes de responder a las objeciones planteadas por los grupos parlamentarios.
note: Legacy Exponer captures the core meaning; the adverb restores the extended, systematic explanation implied by expound. Self-review replaced a looser alternative with explicar detenidamente.

register: Neutral-formal academic and analytical collocation; appropriate when advancing a proposition for subsequent testing or examination.
trap: Spanish normally prefers formular or plantear una hipótesis; Italian ipotesi can prompt omission of the initial h in Spanish hipótesis.
example_tl: Los investigadores formularon la hipótesis de que el descenso del tráfico obedecía a cambios algorítmicos y no a una menor demanda informativa.
example_en: The researchers hypothesized that the decline in traffic was due to algorithmic changes rather than lower demand for news.
cloze: Los investigadores {{c1::formularon la hipótesis}} de que el descenso del tráfico obedecía a cambios algorítmicos y no a una menor demanda informativa.
note: The legacy light-verb rendering is accurate; the note supplies the most conventional collocation and a genuine spelling risk.

register: Neutral-formal in research, legal and analytical writing for deriving a conclusion from evidence or premises.
trap: English infer and imply are often confused: evidence or a reader permits inferring a conclusion, while a speaker or fact can imply it.
example_tl: Los analistas infirieron de los contratos filtrados que la empresa conocía los riesgos del sistema mucho antes de admitirlos públicamente.
example_en: The analysts inferred from the leaked contracts that the company knew about the system's risks long before publicly admitting them.
cloze: Los analistas {{c1::infirieron de}} los contratos filtrados que la empresa conocía los riesgos del sistema mucho antes de admitirlos públicamente.
note: The legacy infinitive is accurate. The fuller headword and inflected example teach government with de and the preterite form infirieron.

register: Neutral-formal for rendering an effect, benefit or advantage ineffective; common in analytical evaluation.
trap: Negar means deny a proposition or refuse something; it does not normally translate negate when one factor cancels the practical effect of another.
example_tl: La opacidad del proceso anuló las ventajas de la consulta pública, pues los ciudadanos nunca supieron qué decisiones seguían abiertas.
example_en: The opacity of the process negated the benefits of the public consultation, since citizens never knew which decisions remained open.
cloze: La opacidad del proceso {{c1::anuló}} las ventajas de la consulta pública, pues los ciudadanos nunca supieron qué decisiones seguían abiertas.
note: The isolated source is polysemous. This note selects cancellation of an effect and materially replaces legacy Negar for that sense.

register: Neutral-formal for carefully weighing consequences, options or competing considerations before making a decision.
trap: Ponderar can mean weigh carefully, but it can also mean praise or assign a statistical weight; sopesar unambiguously foregrounds deliberation.
example_tl: El consejo sopesó los costes diplomáticos de la prohibición antes de restringir la exportación de componentes utilizados en sistemas militares.
example_en: The council pondered the diplomatic costs of the ban before restricting exports of components used in military systems.
cloze: El consejo {{c1::sopesó}} los costes diplomáticos de la prohibición antes de restringir la exportación de componentes utilizados en sistemas militares.
note: The note selects careful weighing before a decision; this is more precise than legacy Reflexionar and distinct from merely contemplating a possible action.

register: Written-formal and academic for advancing a proposition as a premise or explanatory principle.
trap: French postuler can mean apply for a position; in European Spanish that employment sense is solicitar un puesto or presentar una candidatura, not postular.
example_tl: El modelo postula una relación causal entre la concentración mediática y la homogeneización del debate, pero ofrece pruebas meramente correlacionales.
example_en: The model posits a causal relationship between media concentration and homogenization of debate, but offers merely correlational evidence.
cloze: El modelo {{c1::postula}} una relación causal entre la concentración mediática y la homogeneización del debate, pero ofrece pruebas meramente correlacionales.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate for the academic sense selected here; the trap records a relevant French false-friend risk for this learner.

register: Neutral-formal argumentative usage for limiting, refining or adding reservations to a previous statement.
trap: Calificar means rate, characterize or earn eligibility in other senses; it does not mean add nuance or reservations to a claim.
example_tl: La portavoz matizó su afirmación inicial después de que documentos internos demostraran que el sistema había fallado en numerosas ocasiones.
example_en: The spokesperson qualified her initial statement after internal documents showed that the system had failed on numerous occasions.
cloze: La portavoz {{c1::matizó}} su afirmación inicial después de que documentos internos demostraran que el sistema había fallado en numerosas ocasiones.
note: The source is highly polysemous. This note selects argumentative qualification and materially corrects legacy Calificar for that sense.

register: Neutral for expressing doubt about a claim, assumption or institution; poner en tela de juicio is a more emphatic formal variant.
trap: Questioning a person is interrogar a alguien or hacerle preguntas; preguntar does not express challenging the validity of a claim.
example_tl: Varios expertos pusieron en duda la independencia del comité tras conocer los vínculos económicos de dos de sus integrantes.
example_en: Several experts questioned the committee's independence after learning of the financial ties of two of its members.
cloze: Varios expertos {{c1::pusieron en duda}} la independencia del comité tras conocer los vínculos económicos de dos de sus integrantes.
note: The note selects epistemic doubt rather than interrogation. It remains distinct from impugnar, which formally contests the validity of a decision or procedure.

register: Neutral-formal in investigative, regulatory and analytical prose; escrutar is more elevated and often suggests an especially searching examination.
trap: Examinar alone can mean merely inspect or test; the adverb minuciosamente preserves the thorough, critical attention encoded by scrutinize.
example_tl: La comisión examinó minuciosamente los contratos de computación en la nube antes de autorizar que los ministerios migraran datos especialmente sensibles.
example_en: The commission scrutinized the cloud-computing contracts before authorizing the ministries to migrate particularly sensitive data.
cloze: La comisión {{c1::examinó minuciosamente}} los contratos de computación en la nube antes de autorizar que los ministerios migraran datos especialmente sensibles.
note: The legacy rendering captures the core action but omits the thoroughness that distinguishes scrutinize from a general examination.

register: Neutral-formal in legal proceedings and reported controversy; the surrounding wording should preserve that the claim has not been established.
trap: Spanish alegar can also mean adducing a reason or fact in support of a case, so it does not invariably carry the unproven-claim nuance of English allege.
example_tl: El exdirectivo alegó que la plataforma desconocía el uso político de los datos, pero no aportó documentos que respaldaran su versión.
example_en: The former executive alleged that the platform was unaware of the political use of the data, but supplied no documents supporting his account.
cloze: El exdirectivo {{c1::alegó}} que la plataforma desconocía el uso político de los datos, pero no aportó documentos que respaldaran su versión.
note: The legacy cognate is valid in this legal-media sense; the example makes the claim's unverified status explicit rather than treating that nuance as automatic.

register: Neutral-formal for strengthening an argument, institution, position or effect; apuntalar is a more vivid metaphor and often suggests shoring up weakness.
trap: Bolster is commonly figurative here; Spanish does not need a noun corresponding to the literal English cushion or support.
example_tl: Los nuevos registros reforzaron la tesis de que la empresa había coordinado la campaña, aunque todavía no probaban una intervención directa.
example_en: The new records bolstered the thesis that the company had coordinated the campaign, although they still did not prove direct intervention.
cloze: Los nuevos registros {{c1::reforzaron}} la tesis de que la empresa había coordinado la campaña, aunque todavía no probaban una intervención directa.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate for the selected evidential-strengthening sense.

register: Neutral for introducing a potentially delicate subject into a discussion; sacar a colación is somewhat more conversational and rhetorical.
trap: Abordar un asunto means address or tackle it and does not by itself convey that someone is raising it for discussion for the first time.
example_tl: Cuando terminó la reunión técnica, la ministra planteó el asunto de la vigilancia biométrica, que sus asesores habían evitado durante meses.
example_en: When the technical meeting ended, the minister broached the subject of biometric surveillance, which her advisers had avoided for months.
cloze: Cuando terminó la reunión técnica, la ministra {{c1::planteó el asunto}} de la vigilancia biométrica, que sus asesores habían evitado durante meses.
note: Materially refines legacy Abordar by selecting the sense of first introducing a sensitive topic, not subsequently dealing with it.

register: Neutral-formal for intentionally avoiding a rule, safeguard or restriction; sortear can sound less accusatory when the obstacle is practical.
trap: Eludir foregrounds deliberate avoidance, whereas evitar may simply mean preventing or staying away from something without implying an evasive workaround.
example_tl: La empresa creó una filial en otro país para eludir los controles de exportación impuestos a los proveedores de tecnología militar.
example_en: The company created a subsidiary in another country to circumvent the export controls imposed on suppliers of military technology.
cloze: La empresa creó una filial en otro país para {{c1::eludir}} los controles de exportación impuestos a los proveedores de tecnología militar.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate and more precise than a generic evitar for this regulatory-evasion context.

register: Neutral-formal for offsetting an influence, tendency or effect; argumentative countering normally calls for rebatir or responder a instead.
trap: English counter is polysemous: contrarrestar una influencia is natural, but contrarrestar una afirmación is usually less precise than rebatirla.
example_tl: El regulador introdujo auditorías independientes para contrarrestar la influencia que los grandes proveedores ejercían sobre los organismos nacionales de certificación.
example_en: The regulator introduced independent audits to counter the influence that major providers exerted over national certification bodies.
cloze: El regulador introdujo auditorías independientes para {{c1::contrarrestar}} la influencia que los grandes proveedores ejercían sobre los organismos nacionales de certificación.
note: The isolated source is ambiguous; this note deliberately retains the effect-offsetting sense represented by the legacy rendering, distinct from refuting an argument.

register: Neutral-formal for expressing hesitant or reasoned objection; demur itself is uncommon and distinctly formal in contemporary English.
trap: Recusar in Spain normally means formally challenging a judge, expert or other participant for possible bias; it is not a general equivalent of demur.
example_tl: Varios juristas pusieron reparos a la reforma porque permitía al Ejecutivo bloquear contenidos sin autorización judicial ni una vía clara de recurso.
example_en: Several jurists demurred at the reform because it allowed the executive to block content without judicial authorization or a clear avenue of appeal.
cloze: Varios juristas {{c1::pusieron reparos a}} la reforma porque permitía al Ejecutivo bloquear contenidos sin autorización judicial ni una vía clara de recurso.
note: Materially replaces legacy Recusar, which selects a narrow procedural act absent from the English prompt.

register: Neutral-formal for contemptuous mockery, often public; mofarse de is vivid and slightly less formal.
trap: Burlarse de can cover ordinary teasing as well as contemptuous ridicule, while deride normally signals the stronger, dismissive reading.
example_tl: El portavoz ridiculizó las advertencias de los científicos, aunque meses después el Gobierno adoptó casi todas las medidas que ellos habían propuesto.
example_en: The spokesperson derided the scientists' warnings, although months later the government adopted almost all the measures they had proposed.
cloze: El portavoz {{c1::ridiculizó}} las advertencias de los científicos, aunque meses después el Gobierno adoptó casi todas las medidas que ellos habían propuesto.
note: The note chooses public, contemptuous dismissal; legacy Burlarse is possible but underspecifies that force without context.

register: Neutral-formal for distributing information or findings widely; divulgar especially suits making specialist knowledge accessible to a broader public.
trap: The cognate diseminar is possible but often evokes physical dispersal or decentralized spread; difundir is the safer default for information and findings.
example_tl: El consorcio difundió los resultados preliminares entre periodistas y organizaciones civiles antes de que la revista académica completara la revisión por pares.
example_en: The consortium disseminated the preliminary results among journalists and civil-society organizations before the academic journal completed peer review.
cloze: El consorcio {{c1::difundió}} los resultados preliminares entre periodistas y organizaciones civiles antes de que la revista académica completara la revisión por pares.
note: The legacy rendering is the idiomatic default for informational dissemination; the note records the tempting but more marked cognate.

register: Neutral-formal for causing a response, reaction or feeling; obtaining information from a person instead requires obtener or recabar.
trap: Elicit alternates between causing a reaction and drawing out information; suscitar fits the former but not questions designed to elicit factual answers.
example_tl: Las revelaciones suscitaron una respuesta inmediata del Parlamento, que exigió explicaciones sobre la venta de datos sanitarios a empresas aseguradoras.
example_en: The revelations elicited an immediate response from Parliament, which demanded explanations about the sale of health data to insurance companies.
cloze: Las revelaciones {{c1::suscitaron}} una respuesta inmediata del Parlamento, que exigió explicaciones sobre la venta de datos sanitarios a empresas aseguradoras.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate for the reaction-causing sense selected here; the note explicitly excludes the information-obtaining sense.

register: Neutral with a mildly critical implication when added details make an account more impressive but less reliable; literal decoration uses adornar or embellecer.
trap: Embellecer emphasizes making something beautiful; with an account, adornar more readily suggests adding attractive, exaggerated or invented details.
example_tl: El documental adornó el relato del fundador con episodios heroicos que antiguos empleados consideran exagerados o directamente inventados.
example_en: The documentary embellished the founder's story with heroic episodes that former employees consider exaggerated or outright invented.
cloze: El documental {{c1::adornó el relato}} del fundador con episodios heroicos que antiguos empleados consideran exagerados o directamente inventados.
note: Materially narrows legacy Embellecer to the figurative account-enhancing sense; the object in the headword prevents an unintended decorative reading.

register: Neutral-formal for publicly adopting or advocating a principle, doctrine or cause; propugnar is more elevated and programmatic.
trap: Do not confuse espouse with Spanish esposar, which means to handcuff; defender or propugnar expresses support for a position.
example_tl: El candidato defendió una visión de soberanía digital que sus propios asesores habían calificado meses antes de inviable y económicamente costosa.
example_en: The candidate espoused a vision of digital sovereignty that his own advisers had described months earlier as unviable and economically costly.
cloze: El candidato {{c1::defendió}} una visión de soberanía digital que sus propios asesores habían calificado meses antes de inviable y económicamente costosa.
note: Legacy Propugnar is valid but more elevated than the broad English source; defender is the most reusable serious-register rendering.

register: Neutral for creating a false account, source or excuse; inventarse is especially idiomatic in Spain and makes the fabrication explicit.
trap: Fabricar is standard for making objects and can collocate figuratively with pruebas or pretextos, but it is not the safest automatic choice for every false account.
example_tl: El consultor inventó una fuente anónima para sostener que el programa de vigilancia contaba con respaldo mayoritario entre los funcionarios europeos.
example_en: The consultant fabricated an anonymous source to claim that the surveillance program enjoyed majority support among European officials.
cloze: El consultor {{c1::inventó}} una fuente anónima para sostener que el programa de vigilancia contaba con respaldo mayoritario entre los funcionarios europeos.
note: Materially replaces the overly automatic legacy cognate and selects fabrication of false information rather than physical manufacture.

register: Neutral, often under negation, for succeeding in understanding something difficult or perplexing; the English verb is somewhat more marked.
trap: Profundizar en algo means study it in greater depth, not necessarily manage to understand it; fathom describes achieved or attempted comprehension.
example_tl: Los investigadores aún no alcanzan a comprender por qué el algoritmo penaliza sistemáticamente las noticias locales pese a sus elevados índices de lectura.
example_en: Researchers still cannot fathom why the algorithm systematically penalizes local news despite its high readership figures.
cloze: Los investigadores aún no {{c1::alcanzan a comprender}} por qué el algoritmo penaliza sistemáticamente las noticias locales pese a sus elevados índices de lectura.
note: Materially replaces legacy Profundizar, which denotes deeper investigation rather than successful understanding. Self-review replaced the less idiomatic tasa de lectura with índices de lectura.

register: Neutral-formal for deriving limited information from evidence or scattered material; the agricultural sense of glean is a separate, uncommon use.
trap: Espigar is mainly literal or literary and is not the normal default for obtaining information from documents, metadata or indirect evidence.
example_tl: Los periodistas extrajeron información de los metadatos sobre el origen de la filtración, aunque ningún dato identificaba por sí solo al responsable.
example_en: The journalists gleaned information from the metadata about the leak's origin, although no single item of data identified the culprit by itself.
cloze: Los periodistas {{c1::extrajeron información de}} los metadatos sobre el origen de la filtración, aunque ningún dato identificaba por sí solo al responsable.
note: Materially replaces legacy Espigar with the productive analytical rendering for information inferred or gathered from a source.

register: Pejorative; insistir machaconamente works in serious commentary, while machacar con is more colloquial and common in speech.
trap: The intended English construction is harp on something; legacy Arpar is not a standard Spanish equivalent and loses the repeated, tiresome insistence.
example_tl: Durante la comparecencia, el ministro insistió machaconamente en el coste de la transición, sin mencionar los subsidios concedidos a las empresas contaminantes.
example_en: During the hearing, the minister harped on the cost of the transition without mentioning the subsidies granted to polluting companies.
cloze: Durante la comparecencia, el ministro {{c1::insistió machaconamente en}} el coste de la transición, sin mencionar los subsidios concedidos a las empresas contaminantes.
note: Materially corrects the broken legacy rendering and restores the particle-dependent, negative-pragmatic sense of harp on.

register: Neutral-formal for instilling a belief, value or habit through repeated teaching; common in educational and institutional criticism.
trap: Spanish admits inculcar algo en alguien and inculcarle algo a alguien; when using the first pattern, retain en before the person receiving the teaching.
example_tl: La academia inculcó en los nuevos diplomáticos el deber de guardar confidencialidad, incluso cuando este dificultaba denunciar abusos dentro de la propia institución.
example_en: The academy inculcated in the new diplomats a duty to maintain confidentiality, even when this made it harder to report abuses within the institution itself.
cloze: La academia {{c1::inculcó en}} los nuevos diplomáticos el deber de guardar confidencialidad, incluso cuando este dificultaba denunciar abusos dentro de la propia institución.
note: The legacy cognate is accurate, but the fuller headword and example supply the governed en phrase omitted by the bare infinitive. Self-review replaced deber de confidencialidad with the more explicit deber de guardar confidencialidad.

tl: acusar formalmente a alguien de algo
alts: formular cargos contra alguien por algo
register: Formal legal language; the exact procedural term varies by jurisdiction, so neutral reporting often describes the formal accusation rather than borrowing a foreign institution.
trap: Indict does not mean convict: acusar formalmente initiates or advances a prosecution, whereas condenar means a court has found the defendant guilty.
example_tl: Un gran jurado acusó formalmente al exdirectivo de fraude electrónico y conspiración por ocultar pagos destinados a funcionarios extranjeros.
example_en: A grand jury indicted the former executive for electronic fraud and conspiracy over concealing payments intended for foreign officials.
cloze: Un gran jurado {{c1::acusó formalmente}} {{c1::al}} exdirectivo {{c1::de}} fraude electrónico y conspiración por ocultar pagos destinados a funcionarios extranjeros.
note: The legacy Acusar is directionally correct but omits procedural formality. Spanish law has no exact institution-wide equivalent to the Anglo-American indictment.

register: Formal or elevated praise in the English source; elogiar is less marked in Spanish, while ensalzar restores a more rhetorical tone.
trap: Alabar is valid but can sound personal, moral or devotional depending on context; policy and media prose often prefers elogiar.
example_tl: El editorial elogió públicamente la transparencia del ministerio, pese a que los documentos divulgados omitían las reuniones con representantes de la industria.
example_en: The editorial publicly lauded the ministry's transparency, even though the disclosed documents omitted its meetings with industry representatives.
cloze: El editorial {{c1::elogió públicamente}} la transparencia del ministerio, pese a que los documentos divulgados omitían las reuniones con representantes de la industria.
note: Legacy Alabar is possible; the selected rendering is more idiomatic in institutional media criticism, with public praise made explicit.

register: Formal institutional term for officially publishing a law or provision so that it is observed; the competent authority depends on the constitutional system.
trap: Spanish promulgar is narrower than simply announcing or promoting a policy, and sancionar una ley may denote a distinct constitutional step rather than a synonym.
example_tl: El jefe del Estado promulgó la nueva ley de ciberseguridad una vez concluido el control constitucional previo exigido por el ordenamiento jurídico nacional.
example_en: The head of state promulgated the new cybersecurity law once the prior constitutional review required by the national legal system had concluded.
cloze: El jefe del Estado {{c1::promulgó}} la nueva ley de ciberseguridad una vez concluido el control constitucional previo exigido por el ordenamiento jurídico nacional.
note: The legacy cognate is accurate in the legal sense selected here; the object-bearing headword prevents overextension to general advocacy or publicity. Self-review made the pre-promulgation legal sequence explicit.

register: Neutral-formal for a firm, often abrupt rejection of a proposal or approach; rebuffing a person may instead be desairar a alguien.
trap: Legacy Desairar fits rejecting a person or advance in a discourteous way, but it is not the natural default when the object is an institutional proposal.
example_tl: La plataforma rechazó de plano la propuesta europea de interoperabilidad, alegando que abrir sus servicios pondría en peligro la seguridad de los usuarios.
example_en: The platform rebuffed the European interoperability proposal, claiming that opening its services would endanger user security.
cloze: La plataforma {{c1::rechazó de plano}} la propuesta europea de interoperabilidad, alegando que abrir sus servicios pondría en peligro la seguridad de los usuarios.
note: Materially replaces legacy Desairar for the proposal-rejection sense and preserves the force of the English verb with de plano.

register: Neutral-formal in evidential and argumentative prose; properly used when reasons or evidence establish that a claim is false.
trap: Refutar is stronger than negar or discrepar: merely rejecting a claim does not refute it unless counterevidence or reasoning demonstrates its falsity.
example_tl: El análisis independiente refutó la afirmación de que el sistema reducía los sesgos, pues demostró un perjuicio sistemático para los barrios pobres.
example_en: The independent analysis refuted the claim that the system reduced bias, as it demonstrated systematic harm to poor neighborhoods.
cloze: El análisis independiente {{c1::refutó}} la afirmación de que el sistema reducía los sesgos, pues demostró un perjuicio sistemático para los barrios pobres.
note: The legacy cognate is exact, but the note preserves the often-eroded evidential requirement that distinguishes refutation from denial.

register: Formal and emphatic for publicly disowning a position, act or association, often with moral condemnation.
trap: Repudiar is substantially stronger than a routine rechazar: it commonly signals categorical disavowal and may imply moral or political distancing.
example_tl: El partido repudió públicamente la campaña xenófoba de su antiguo portavoz, pero evitó explicar por qué había tolerado mensajes similares durante años.
example_en: The party publicly repudiated its former spokesperson's xenophobic campaign but avoided explaining why it had tolerated similar messages for years.
cloze: El partido {{c1::repudió públicamente}} la campaña xenófoba de su antiguo portavoz, pero evitó explicar por qué había tolerado mensajes similares durante años.
note: The legacy cognate is accurate; the example fixes the strong public-disavowal sense that warrants retaining it beside more general rejection verbs.

register: Figurative and somewhat literary for prolonged, often uneasy reflection; darle vueltas is the neutral conversational alternative in Spain.
trap: Rumiar also literally describes a ruminant chewing cud, so an abstract object or suitable context is needed to force the reflective sense.
example_tl: Durante semanas, el gabinete rumió las consecuencias diplomáticas del acuerdo antes de aceptar unas garantías que inicialmente había considerado insuficientes.
example_en: For weeks, the cabinet ruminated on the agreement's diplomatic consequences before accepting assurances it had initially considered insufficient.
cloze: Durante semanas, el gabinete {{c1::rumió}} las consecuencias diplomáticas del acuerdo antes de aceptar unas garantías que inicialmente había considerado insuficientes.
note: The legacy rendering is valid but underdetermined in isolation; the abstract object selects the figurative sense and avoids overlap with neutral reflexionar.

register: Formal, especially in contracts, statutes and negotiated agreements; establecer expresamente is less technical and often clearer outside legal prose.
trap: In hypothetical reasoning, English stipulate can mean assume; Spanish estipular normally sets an explicit condition or term, not a provisional assumption.
example_tl: El convenio estipula que los proveedores deberán revelar cualquier subcontratación antes de transferir datos sanitarios fuera del Espacio Económico Europeo.
example_en: The agreement stipulates that providers must disclose any subcontracting before transferring health data outside the European Economic Area.
cloze: El convenio {{c1::estipula}} que los proveedores deberán revelar cualquier subcontratación antes de transferir datos sanitarios fuera del Espacio Económico Europeo.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate for the formal condition-setting sense selected here; the note excludes the distinct hypothetical use of English stipulate.

register: Neutral-formal in evidential, legal and analytical prose; acreditar is especially apt when the evidence establishes a fact or allegation.
trap: Sustanciar is not the default cognate: in Spanish legal usage it commonly means to conduct or process proceedings, rather than support a claim with evidence.
example_tl: La empresa no pudo fundamentar su acusación con pruebas verificables, pese a que había repetido la misma versión ante tres comisiones parlamentarias.
example_en: The company could not substantiate its accusation with verifiable evidence, although it had repeated the same account before three parliamentary committees.
cloze: La empresa no pudo {{c1::fundamentar}} su acusación {{c1::con pruebas}} verificables, pese a que había repetido la misma versión ante tres comisiones parlamentarias.
note: The legacy rendering captures the core sense; the production headword adds the evidential complement that distinguishes substantiation from bare assertion. Self-review removed acreditar algo because it did not substitute naturally with the example's accusation object.

register: Neutral-formal for a tentative conclusion drawn from incomplete evidence; more deliberate than a casual suponer.
trap: Suponer is broader and may express an unsupported assumption; surmise normally suggests a tentative inference from limited clues.
example_tl: Los analistas conjeturaron que el apagón había sido deliberado, aunque la ausencia de registros impedía atribuirlo con rigor a ningún actor.
example_en: The analysts surmised that the outage had been deliberate, although the lack of records prevented them from rigorously attributing it to any actor.
cloze: Los analistas {{c1::conjeturaron}} que el apagón había sido deliberado, aunque la ausencia de registros impedía atribuirlo con rigor a ningún actor.
note: Materially refines legacy Suponer by preserving the tentative inference from incomplete evidence.

register: Neutral in media and commercial criticism for public, interested praise; ensalzar is more elevated and foregrounds praise rather than promotion.
trap: The English verb has no usable Spanish cognate: choose promocionar, presentar como or ensalzar according to whether marketing, framing or emphatic praise dominates.
example_tl: El ministro promocionó el sistema biométrico como una garantía de seguridad, mientras evitaba explicar quién conservaría los datos y durante cuánto tiempo.
example_en: The minister touted the biometric system as a guarantee of security while avoiding explaining who would retain the data and for how long.
cloze: El ministro {{c1::promocionó}} el sistema biométrico como una garantía de seguridad, mientras evitaba explicar quién conservaría los datos y durante cuánto tiempo.
note: Materially replaces legacy Tout, which leaves the English word untranslated and is not a Spanish verb.

register: Neutral-formal and usually critical of portraying a person or group as reprehensible; vilipendiar is markedly more elevated and literary.
trap: Vilipendiar is valid Spanish, but its elevated register makes it a poor automatic choice for the current media use of English vilify.
example_tl: La campaña demonizó a las organizaciones humanitarias, presentándolas como cómplices de las redes criminales sin aportar pruebas de esa colaboración.
example_en: The campaign vilified humanitarian organizations, portraying them as accomplices of criminal networks without providing evidence of that collaboration.
cloze: La campaña {{c1::demonizó}} {{c1::a}} las organizaciones humanitarias, presentándolas como cómplices de las redes criminales sin aportar pruebas de esa colaboración.
note: The legacy rendering is semantically possible but overly elevated for the professional media context selected here.

register: Neutral-formal when evidence or circumstances provide sufficient grounds for a conclusion or action; other senses require autorizar or garantizar.
trap: Garantizar means ensure or guarantee; it does not express the evidential sense in which facts warrant a conclusion.
example_tl: Las irregularidades detectadas justifican una auditoría independiente, pero no el cierre inmediato de un servicio del que dependen miles de usuarios.
example_en: The irregularities detected warrant an independent audit, but not the immediate shutdown of a service on which thousands of users depend.
cloze: Las irregularidades detectadas {{c1::justifican}} una auditoría independiente, pero no el cierre inmediato de un servicio del que dependen miles de usuarios.
note: Materially replaces legacy Garantizar, which selects the ensure or guarantee sense rather than the provide-grounds sense used here. Self-review replaced an awkward justificar concluir construction and removed a weaker alternative.

register: Neutral-formal in argumentation for a claim or position that someone advances and defends; not necessarily a hostile dispute.
trap: Spanish contención means restraint, containment or cost control; it is a false friend for contention in the sense of an argued claim.
example_tl: La tesis de que la moderación privada protege por sí sola el debate público ignora los incentivos comerciales que premian la polarización.
example_en: The contention that private moderation protects public debate by itself ignores the commercial incentives that reward polarization.
cloze: {{c1::La tesis}} de que la moderación privada protege por sí sola el debate público ignora los incentivos comerciales que premian la polarización.
note: Materially replaces legacy Contención, a false friend that does not denote an argumentative claim. Self-review shortened the alternative to la afirmación so it substitutes naturally in the example's de que frame.

register: Neutral in explanatory and institutional prose; esclarecimiento is more formal and often suggests resolving something obscure or disputed.
trap: Although elucidación exists, it is rare and markedly learned in current Spanish; aclaración or esclarecimiento is normally more idiomatic.
example_tl: La aclaración del tribunal disipó una ambigüedad que permitía a las plataformas excluir a investigadores independientes de sus archivos publicitarios.
example_en: The court's elucidation dispelled an ambiguity that allowed platforms to exclude independent researchers from their advertising archives.
cloze: {{c1::La aclaración}} del tribunal disipó una ambigüedad que permitía a las plataformas excluir a investigadores independientes de sus archivos publicitarios.
note: Materially replaces legacy Elucidación with the idiomatic default; the cognate remains possible only in unusually learned prose.

register: Neutral-formal in analysis and criticism for a valuable new understanding or observation; the exact noun phrase depends on what the insight contains.
trap: Perspicacia normally names a person's capacity for sharp understanding, not one countable insight produced by a study or argument.
example_tl: El estudio aporta una idea reveladora sobre cómo los sistemas de recomendación convierten pequeñas preferencias iniciales en patrones duraderos de consumo informativo.
example_en: The study offers an insight into how recommendation systems turn small initial preferences into lasting patterns of news consumption.
cloze: El estudio aporta {{c1::una idea reveladora}} sobre cómo los sistemas de recomendación convierten pequeñas preferencias iniciales en patrones duraderos de consumo informativo.
note: Materially replaces legacy Perspicacia, which denotes the faculty of insight rather than an individual analytical finding.

register: Neutral-formal in debate, litigation and public controversy for a response intended to answer or undermine an opposing claim.
trap: A rebuttal is an opposing response and need not succeed; refutación more strongly presents an argument or evidence as disproving the claim.
example_tl: La réplica de la empresa cuestionó la metodología del informe, pero no respondió a los correos que demostraban la coordinación con el Gobierno.
example_en: The company's rebuttal challenged the report's methodology but did not address the emails that demonstrated coordination with the government.
cloze: {{c1::La réplica}} de la empresa cuestionó la metodología del informe, pero no respondió a los correos que demostraban la coordinación con el Gobierno.
note: Materially refines legacy Refutación by preserving the distinction between an attempted opposing response and a refutation presented as disproof.

register: Neutral-formal for the reasons or basis offered in support of a policy, decision or argument; fundamento foregrounds the underlying basis.
trap: Razonamiento names a reasoning process or line of reasoning; it is not the usual rendering when rationale means the basis offered to justify a decision.
example_tl: La justificación oficial para ampliar la vigilancia se apoya en amenazas hipotéticas y omite cualquier evaluación seria de sus costes democráticos.
example_en: The official rationale for expanding surveillance rests on hypothetical threats and omits any serious assessment of its democratic costs.
cloze: {{c1::La justificación}} oficial para ampliar la vigilancia se apoya en amenazas hipotéticas y omite cualquier evaluación seria de sus costes democráticos.
note: Materially replaces legacy El razonamiento, which denotes the reasoning process rather than the supporting basis. Self-review retained fundamento as the sole alternative because motivo would denote one reason and would not substitute cleanly here.

register: Neutral academic adjective for something conceptual or removed from concrete instances; the feminine form is abstracta.
trap: English abstract is category-ambiguous: the noun is el resumen, but the adjective is abstracto; legacy Resumen selects the wrong category in this adjective sequence.
example_tl: El principio abstracto de neutralidad pierde fuerza cuando los sistemas automatizados distribuyen visibilidad según criterios comerciales opacos y difícilmente impugnables.
example_en: The abstract principle of neutrality loses force when automated systems distribute visibility according to opaque commercial criteria that are difficult to challenge.
cloze: El principio {{c1::abstracto}} de neutralidad pierde fuerza cuando los sistemas automatizados distribuyen visibilidad según criterios comerciales opacos y difícilmente impugnables.
note: Materially corrects legacy Resumen. The source's position at the start of the adjective sequence resolves the otherwise ambiguous English form. Self-review removed teórico because it is not interchangeable with abstracto in every conceptual contrast.

register: Neutral-formal for reasoning that is both logically forceful and persuasive; Spanish often uses a coordinated phrase to preserve both components.
trap: Cogente exists in learned Spanish, especially in legal or philosophical prose, but using it automatically for any persuasive argument makes general analytical writing sound unduly specialized.
example_tl: El comité presentó un argumento sólido y convincente contra el reconocimiento facial, apoyado en auditorías independientes y no en temores meramente hipotéticos.
example_en: The committee presented a cogent argument against facial recognition, grounded in independent audits rather than merely hypothetical fears.
cloze: El comité presentó un argumento {{c1::sólido y convincente}} contra el reconocimiento facial, apoyado en auditorías independientes y no en temores meramente hipotéticos.
note: Materially refines legacy Cogente: the cognate can be valid in learned specialist prose but is not the unmarked general rendering. Self-review used the two-part phrase because convincente alone can describe persuasion without sound reasoning.

register: Basado en hechos is neutral and broadly idiomatic; fáctico is formal and especially common when contrasting factual and normative questions.
trap: Factual does not mean objective or unbiased: a text may report facts accurately while selecting or framing them tendentiously.
example_tl: El reportaje ofrece un relato basado en hechos, pero omite el contexto histórico necesario para interpretar la conducta de los actores implicados.
example_en: The report offers a factual account but omits the historical context needed to interpret the conduct of the actors involved.
cloze: El reportaje ofrece un relato {{c1::basado en hechos}}, pero omite el contexto histórico necesario para interpretar la conducta de los actores implicados.
note: Legacy Factual is possible in specialist Spanish, but basado en hechos is the safer general production choice. Self-review removed objetivo and veraz because neither is genuinely interchangeable with factual.

register: Neutral-formal for an analysis, observation or person showing penetrating understanding; agudo stresses intellectual sharpness, while lúcido stresses clear judgment.
trap: Do not confuse insightful with intuitive: perspicaz conveys deep understanding, whereas intuitivo means grasped without conscious reasoning or easy to use.
