example_tl: El análisis perspicaz de los archivos muestra que la aparente neutralidad tecnológica encubría decisiones políticas tomadas mucho antes de la crisis.
example_en: The insightful analysis of the archives shows that the apparent technological neutrality concealed political decisions made long before the crisis.
cloze: El análisis {{c1::perspicaz}} de los archivos muestra que la aparente neutralidad tecnológica encubría decisiones políticas tomadas mucho antes de la crisis.
note: Legacy Perspicaz is sound. Self-review retained the card because the adjacent source item Intuitive creates a genuine and consequential English-to-Spanish sense trap.

register: Neutral-formal analytical and journalistic usage for an account that preserves relevant distinctions instead of forcing a simple binary.
trap: Avoid *nuanciado, a likely calque from French nuancé or Portuguese nuançado; standard Spanish normally uses matizado or con matices.
example_tl: El diagnóstico matizado reconoce que la moderación automática reduce ciertos abusos, pero también amplifica sesgos cuando opera sin supervisión humana efectiva.
example_en: The nuanced assessment acknowledges that automated moderation reduces certain abuses but also amplifies biases when it operates without effective human oversight.
cloze: El diagnóstico {{c1::matizado}} reconoce que la moderación automática reduce ciertos abusos, pero también amplifica sesgos cuando opera sin supervisión humana efectiva.
note: Legacy Matizado is correct. Self-review retained con matices as the sole alternative because it substitutes naturally in the example without changing the claim.

register: Critical neutral-formal usage for a claim or action that oversteps what the speaker's authority, knowledge or evidence justifies.
trap: Do not substitute presumido: it usually describes someone vain or conceited, while presuntuoso can criticize an unwarranted assumption or overreach.
example_tl: Sería presuntuoso que la plataforma afirmara representar el interés público cuando ni siquiera revela cómo prioriza unas voces políticas sobre otras.
example_en: It would be presumptuous for the platform to claim to represent the public interest when it does not even disclose how it prioritizes some political voices over others.
cloze: Sería {{c1::presuntuoso}} que la plataforma afirmara representar el interés público cuando ni siquiera revela cómo prioriza unas voces políticas sobre otras.
note: Legacy Presuntuoso is correct. Self-review removed arrogante as an alternative because it foregrounds attitude rather than the unwarranted overreach tested here.

register: Marked formal and academic usage for specialist material that is difficult to understand and accessible to few readers.
trap: Spanish recóndito often foregrounds something hidden or remote; for intellectually difficult specialist material, abstruso fixes the intended English sense more clearly.
example_tl: El informe convierte una decisión política urgente en un debate abstruso sobre parámetros técnicos que solo dominan los proveedores del sistema.
example_en: The report turns an urgent political decision into a recondite debate about technical parameters understood only by the system's vendors.
cloze: El informe convierte una decisión política urgente en un debate {{c1::abstruso}} sobre parámetros técnicos que solo dominan los proveedores del sistema.
note: Materially refines legacy Recóndito: that cognate is possible, but it readily evokes physical or figurative hiddenness. Self-review chose abstruso to make difficulty of comprehension explicit.

register: Critical academic and journalistic usage for an explanation that erases relevant dimensions of a complex issue; simplista is less technical and more openly dismissive.
trap: Reductivo often means reducing or reduction-related; when English reductive criticizes intellectual oversimplification, Spanish normally prefers reduccionista.
example_tl: La lectura reduccionista del conflicto atribuye toda la violencia al fanatismo religioso y borra décadas de intervención exterior y desigualdad económica.
example_en: The reductive reading of the conflict attributes all the violence to religious fanaticism and erases decades of foreign intervention and economic inequality.
cloze: La lectura {{c1::reduccionista}} del conflicto atribuye toda la violencia al fanatismo religioso y borra décadas de intervención exterior y desigualdad económica.
note: Materially replaces legacy Reductivo for the critical analytical sense. Self-review retained simplista as a natural substitute in the example while documenting its stronger evaluative tone.
